news.headline: Estime (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bears.
news.story: Estime's role in the offense was reduced in Week 10 against the Panthers, which marked Travis Etienne's return from a five-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Estime is a healthy scratch for Sunday's game, which means Alvin Kamara and CJ Donaldson will operate as the rotational options out of the backfield behind Etienne. Estime's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Bengals on Nov. 29.

news.headline: Estime carried the ball seven times for six yards and caught his only target for five yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to Carolina.
news.story: Travis Etienne returned from IR and led the Saints' backfield with 11 touches, although he managed just 34 scrimmage yards, while Alvin Kamara handled five touches and scored two short TDs. Perhaps worse for Estime's role and future value, he was ineffective in short-yardage situations, getting stuffed on three attempts to pick up a first down from two yards out or less, and a miscommunication with Tyler Shough on…

news.headline: Estime's role in the backfield will likely be diminished after Travis Etienne (hamstring) was cleared to return for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
news.story: Estime -- who the Saints claimed off waivers from the Browns on Nov. 3 -- turned 15 carries into 72 yards and a touchdown while logging a five-yard catch during New Orleans' 23-22 overtime win over Cleveland in Week 9. He split backfield duties with Alvin Kamara in that contest, but both running backs figure to have their snaps reduced due to the return of Etienne on Sunday.

news.headline: Rivers rushed 15 times for 81 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: Amazingly, all 15 of Rivers' carries came on the Rams' final drive of the game, where they ran 17 plays to kill the final 12 minutes and 15 seconds of the clock. Rivers rushed 15 straight times before Matthew Stafford performed a pair of kneel-downs to end the game. It will be interesting to see if Rivers' efficiency was enough to earn him more carries before garbage time moving forward, especially after Kyren…

news.headline: Douglas caught one of three passes for four yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: The Patriots' offense was effective on the first drive of the game, but that was where the good news ended for New England after Drake Maye was knocked out for the rest of the contest due to an ankle injury. Tommy DeVito took over under center, and the offense struggled to move down the field for the rest of the game. For Douglas, it was the third time this season that he was held to one catch, with the last…

news.headline: Johnson (ankle) was a nonparticipant at the Bears' walkthrough practice Tuesday.
news.story: Johnson was considered unavailable for practice for a second straight day as he continues to nurse an ankle injury he suffered in Week 11 against the Saints. If the running back is unable to play Thursday versus the Lions, Salvon Ahmed would be a top candidate to be elevated from the practice squad for a second week in a row.

news.headline: Johnson (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.story: The running back injured his ankle on kickoff coverage in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Saints and had to be carted off. He'll have two more chances to get on the practice field ahead of Thursday's matchup with the Lions, but he does not appear likely to play at this point. D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai are healthy at the top of Chicago's running back depth chart.

news.headline: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Johnson injured his ankle while on kickoff coverage early in the first quarter. He was carted off the field, and medical staff have determined that the injury is severe enough for Johnson to be sidelined for the rest of Sunday's contest. Salvon Ahmed will move into the RB3 role behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai in Johnson's absence.

news.headline: Kamara rushed one time for one yard and caught a one-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
news.story: The veteran running back played just eight of 72 offensive snaps, while both CJ Donaldson and Travis Etienne played 32 each with Audric Estime a healthy inactive. Kamara has touched the ball just seven times on 24 snaps over the past two weeks, but he's turned three of those touches into short touchdowns. The Saints' three-man backfield continues to be one to try and avoid when making fantasy lineup decisions.…

news.headline: Kamra rushed two times for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added three catches for 10 yards and an additional touchdown on four targets.
news.story: With Travis Etienne back from his weeks-long hamstring injury that saw him miss five games while on injured reserve, the Saints deployed a three-man backfield committee against Carolina. Kamara scored a couple touchdowns, but it was a fluky performance on just five touches and 16 offensive snaps. Audric Estime logged 27 snaps and handled eight touches, while Etienne played 21 snaps and touched the ball 11 times.…

news.headline: Samuel logged two carries for 27 yards, gathered in three of four targets for 20 yards and returned two kickoffs for 57 yards during Sunday's 35-10 win against the Vikings in Mexico City.
news.story: Samuel didn't come close to replicating the 109 yards from scrimmage and two TDs on six touches that he accrued during a Week 10 shootout in Dallas, but he continued to mix into the offense in all realms, as he's ranged from two to eight touches in each of his seven appearances this season. Overall, he's averaging 11.7 yards per catch and a whopping 13.1 yards per carry to go with five total touchdowns in 2026,…

news.headline: Nailor caught one of five targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
news.story: Nailor caught one pass for the second straight week, and he has exceeded 20 receiving yards only one time since Week 1. The wide receiver was unable to capitalize on the absence of Brock Bowers (ankle) in Week 11, and Nailor figures to remain an unattractive fantasy option in Week 12 against the Browns.

news.story: Bernard went without a catch for the first time since Week 1, and his three targets were his fewest since the team's Week 4 loss to the Browns. The wide receiver led his position in offensive snaps (58), besting DK Metcalf (50) in that regard. Bernard entered Week 10 having recorded multiple receptions in five straight contests, and he'll have a good shot to get back on track in Week 11 versus the Eagles.

news.headline: Cooper caught four of his five targets for 59 yards in the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: Cooper played 46 offensive snaps and 15 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver continues to see a significant snap share for the Eagles, drawing two more targets than rookie first-round pick Makai Lemon in the Week 11 win.

news.story: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. news.headline: Shough is no longer wearing a protect glove on his left (non-throwing) hand at Thursday's practice, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
news.story: The second-year quarterback suffered two broken bones in his left hand back on Oct. 5 and has been playing with the glove ever since. He's also been able to only hand the ball off with his right hand since suffering the injury. Shough has completed 66.8 percent of his passes for 2,173 yards, 15 touchdowns and seven interceptions across nine starts this season. He's averaging one full yard less per pass attempt…

news.story: It was the third time this season that Kupp recorded only one catch, but the veteran wide receiver made his lone reception count when he found open space on a broken play to connect with Drew Lock for a TD late in the first quarter. It was the third touchdown catch of the season for Kupp, two of which have come over his last three outings. He'll enter the bye with a 23-272-3 line on 35 targets through 10…

news.story: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
news.story: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

news.story: Brissett looked like a natural fit in coordinator Declan Doyle's offense despite having only practiced a handful of days with the Ravens following his trade from the Cardinals, amassing his highest passing yardage total since Week 11 of last season. As he'd often done with Trey McBride in Arizona, Brissett focused heavily on the tight-end position in his Baltimore debut, connecting with Mark Andrews and Josh Cuevas…

A.J. Brown (hamstring) also didn't last long in his latest return to action. New England gets a bye in Week 11, giving the team's injured stars a chance to recover, so Hollins' role and usage may not become clear until…

news.headline: Worthy caught two of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: Worthy was able to eclipse 30 receiving yards for just the second time in the last five weeks, but it was a step in the right direction after being blanked on three targets in Week 10. The wide receiver's biggest moment of the game came in the fourth quarter when he connected with quarterback Patrick Mahomes for an 18-yard touchdown. news.story: Worthy ran a team-high 37 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks, but on a day Mahomes targeted nine different players, Worthy was the only one to not record a catch. With Josh Downs now in the fold and working to get comfortable in the offense, Worthy's role will likely only continue to shrink. On just eight routes in his team debut Sunday, Downs posted a 4-53-1 receiving line on five targets. Worthy hasn't…

news.headline: Williams caught two passes for 27 yards on two targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
news.story: As he's been doing since making his season debut in Week 6, Williams operated as the Packers' third receiver against Minnesota. He logged 20 offensive snaps and ran 16 routes on 37 dropbacks. Williams has yet to hit 50 receiving yards in any of his five games this season and has no real fantasy appeal in 12-team fantasy leagues. He's well behind Matthew Golden, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft in the order for…

news.headline: Dotson caught three passes for 63 yards on six targets in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: Dotson has yet to hit 100 receiving yards in a game this season and has just two touchdowns, but he leads the league averaging 21.9 yards per catch, turning his 19 grabs into 416 yards through 10 games. He's fighting for leftover opportunities behind Drake London, Bijan Robinson and Kyle Pitts in Atlanta's offense. Dotson isn't a reliable fantasy option down the stretch and headed into the Falcons' Week 11 bye.

news.headline: Donaldson logged a five-yard carry and brought in all four of his targets for 12 yards during the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
news.story: Donaldson recorded season highs in both catches and targets, and he finished third on the Saints in both of those categories behind Chris Olave and Devaughn Vele. However, Donaldson coughed up the football on his first catch of the game early in the second quarter, which the Bears offense capitalized on with a six-play drive that ended with a three-yard touchdown pass from Caleb Williams to D'Andre Swift.…

news.headline: Donaldson (shoulder) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: Donaldson missed the Saints' last three games due to a shoulder injury, but his full practice Wednesday indicates that he'll be available for Sunday's road game against the Bears. Even if Donaldson does suit up, his role in the backfield figures to be minimal, seeing as Travis Etienne is off injured reserve and Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime are also available for the Saints.

If he's diagnosed with a concussion, he'll be subject to league protocol in order to gain clearance to play again, but the Falcons are on bye in Week 11, so he'll have plenty of time to recover for a Week 12 road matchup with the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

news.story: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

news.story: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.

McMillan has slowed down since a torrid start to the season, but he still sports a 55-731-4 line on 87 targets through 10 games heading into a Week 12 clash with the Buccaneers.

news.story: Robinson's snap count was fourth-most among San Francisco's wide receivers, but his role in the offense shrunk due to the return of Deebo Samuel and the acquisition of Keenan Allen at the Nov. 10 trade deadline. Brandin Cooks (coach's decision) was a healthy scratch for Week 10, and Robinson could join the former on the sidelines for Week 11 against the Vikings on Nov. 22, if veteran wide receiver Mike Evans…

news.headline: McLaughlin was limited to one snap on offense and none on special teams in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.story: Since Week 7, McLaughlin has logged just three snaps on offense in the Browns' ensuing three games, but prior to Sunday, he still appeared to be in the mix for work on kickoff returns. However, Isaiah Bond and Malachi Corley have since taken over as the team's preferred kickoff returners, leaving McLaughlin without a role on special teams. McLaughlin will likely continue to see little use as Cleveland's No. 3 back…

news.headline: Young caught one of two targets for a four-yard touchdown during Monday night's 22-20 loss to the Commanders.
news.story: Young reeled in his first pass since Week 3, and he notched his first career touchdown in the process. The wide receiver connected with quarterback Joe Burrow for a four-yard score in the third quarter, momentarily providing Cincinnati with a 17-10 lead. Young's 22 offensive snaps ranked third at his position behind Ja'Marr Chase (56) and Tee Higgins (56) while ahead of Dohnte Meyers (21), but Young may revert to a…

news.headline: Tolbert caught his only target for 17 yards during Sunday's 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
news.story: Tolbert played just eight of the Dolphins' 55 offensive snaps in Week 11, and he drew just one target for the third time in his last five games. Miami will probably continue to lean primarily on Malik Washington, Caleb Douglas and Chris Bell at wide receiver in a Week 12 matchup versus the Jets.

news.headline: Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.story: The wideout was active for just the fifth time in nine games this season and played 11 of 69 offensive snaps. He ran only five routes and caught a 34-yard touchdown from fellow receiver Malik Washington on a trick play early in the second quarter. Tolbert has no fantasy appeal moving forward, as he has just four catches for 79 yards on six targets this season.

news.headline: Juszczyk caught both of his targets for 13 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
news.story: Juszczyk was able to reel in his first two passes since Week 7, notching his fourth multi-catch performance of the year. The fullback has now caught 10 of 13 targets for 89 yards and two touchdowns while also adding a four-yard rush over nine contests to open the 2026 season.

The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The…
news.story: Nacua is expected to miss "a couple of months" after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, per Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com. With Nacua and Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) sidelined for Week 10 against the Cardinals, Mumpfield operated as the Rams' WR1 for that contest and finished with three catches (on four targets) for 81 yards in a 34-6 win for Los Angeles. The Rams are "hopeful" that Adams will return soon,…

Skowronek (calf) did not practice Tuesday.
news.story: The 29-year-old appears to have suffered a setback with his calf injury, as he opened Week 12 as a non-participant in practice Tuesday. Skowronek missed the Steelers' last three games due to the same injury. He will likely need to upgrade his practice status for a chance to play Friday against the Broncos.

news.headline: Lance failed to catch his only target and added 47 yards on kickoff returns during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
news.story: Lance was unable to reel in a deep pass from quarterback Tyler Shough in the first quarter, and he didn't get another look the rest of the game. The wide receiver was on the field for 21 offensive snaps, ranking fourth at his position behind Devaughn Vele (64), Chris Olave (62) and Jordyn Tyson (36) in the contest. Lance will continue to primarily serve as a special-teams asset for New Orleans moving forward,…

news.headline: Lance returned three kickoffs for 55 yards during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: The rookie fourth-rounder didn't see a target from Tyler Shough during Sunday's loss, and Lance has not recorded a catch in each of his last two outings, coinciding with the return of 2026 first-round wide receiver Jordyn Tyson. Lance's nine offensive snaps were a season low, and he figures to be limited to return duties now that Tyson is back in the fold. The Saints will hit the road for Week 11 against the Bears…

news.headline: Coleman failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: With Chris Bell (knee) back from his absence, Coleman reverted to WR4 duties for Miami, playing just 12 of 57 offensive snaps. He has no fantasy appeal while Caleb Douglas, Malik Washington and Bell are healthy. Coleman has been extremely inefficient through 10 games this season, catching just nine of 28 targets for 88 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Coleman logged one catch for six yards on six targets in Sunday's Week 10 loss to Indianapolis.
news.story: Coleman couldn't get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who made his first NFL regular-season appearance. In fact, Coleman has been quiet inefficient regardless of who has thrown him the ball this year, as he has just nine receptions on 27 targets through nine games. Two of his nine catches have been touchdowns, but he's not getting enough touches to be a trustworthy fantasy option.

news.headline: Armstrong caught his only target for a 43-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
news.story: The wideout played just 17 of 64 offensive snaps against Atlanta and ran only seven pass routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks. Armstrong was tasked with blocking duties on 10 of his snaps. He still managed to catch his first career touchdown in the fourth quarter with the game already well out of hand. Armstrong is not on the fantasy radar.

news.headline: Walker recorded 211 kickoff-return yards, including an 86-yard touchdown, and one catch for 34 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.story: The wide receiver filled a returner role for the first time this season and did well. Walker has seen just 10 targets on offense in 2026, so he's not much of a factor in fantasy leagues at the moment, but he could garner more opportunities on special teams following Sunday's success.

news.headline: Chism did not catch his only target during the Patriots' 35-10 loss against the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.story: A.J. Brown (hamstring) returned from a two-game absence caused by ankle and knee injuries in Week 10, and as a result, Chism saw his lowest snap count this season (8) since he was a healthy scratch in Week 1. His role coming out of the Patriots' bye in Week 11 will probably depend heavily on the availability of Brown, who picked up a hamstring issue against the Lions.

news.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Coleman surges among RBs, Taylor sinks
The reasons Dopp is picking Dak Prescott over Patrick Mahomes in Week 12

Sarratt (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Carolina.
news.story: Sarratt has been active for two games this season, most recently appearing in Week 4 versus the Titans. Since then, he's been held out. His next opportunity to play will come in Week 12 versus the Texans.

news.headline: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.story: Thompson's inactive status doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he entered the weekend as doubtful due to a hamstring injury. He hasn't played since Week 2 against the Raiders, and his next chance to see the field is Week 12 against the Patriots on Nov. 29.

news.headline: Thompson (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.story: Thompson has been sidelined by a hamstring injury and has not seen regular-season action since Week 2 against the Raiders. If he's ruled out for Sunday's game, then the rookie fourth-rounder's next chance to play would be Week 12 against the Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 29.

news.headline: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.
news.story: Thompson will not suit up for Monday's primetime clash after being listed as doubtful following a third consecutive DNP on Saturday, and it's no surprise the fourth-round rookie is unable to play in Monday's game. Derius Davis will take on the role of No. 4 wide receiver in the contest behind starters Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris and KeAndre Lambert-Smith.

news.headline: Watkins caught one of his three targets for 26 yards during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
news.story: Watkins played just five offensive snaps for the Colts in Thursday night's game. Despite playing only 10 percent of the offensive snaps, Watkins totaled the third-highest yardage by Colts pass catchers on the night with his 26-yard grab. The reserve wide receiver could see an expanded role down the stretch as the Colts experiment with starting quarterback Anthony Richardson in what is all but a lost season.

news.headline: The Colts signed Watkins from their practice squad to their 53-man roster Tuesday.
news.story: A spot on the 53-man roster opened up when Indianapolis placed linebacker Jaylon Carlies (neck) on IR, and the team elected to give Watkins the opening. The veteran wideout was elevated for Sunday's Week 10 win over Miami, but he didn't end up playing. With that said, there could be an opportunity for Watkins to garner some work in the passing game after Indianapolis traded Josh Downs to the Chiefs and Keenan Allen…

news.headline: Watkins reverted to the Colts' practice squad Monday.
news.story: Watkins was active for Sunday's win over the Dolphins but didn't play any snaps. The wide receiver has two more practice-squad elevations remaining this season before he would need to be signed to the Colts' 53-man roster in order to suit up on game days.

news.headline: Singleton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.story: Week 11 marks the fifth time in six games that Singleton will be a healthy scratch, despite the fact that Tyjae Spears (knee) was placed on injured reserve Saturday. As such, Michael Carter and Julius Chestnut will operate as the Titans' rotational options in the backfield behind workhorse running back Tony Pollard on Sunday. Singleton's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Jaguars on Nov. 29.

news.headline: Singleton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
news.story: Singleton remains a healthy scratch for Week 10. The fifth-round rookie has played in four contests, logging seven rush attempts for 12 yards. Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears are set to continue as the main rushers for the Titans' offense.

news.headline: Quitoriano played all 13 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: Since coming out of nowhere to post two receiving touchdowns in his Cardinals debut back in Week 5 against the Lions, Quitoriano has fallen out of the mix for playing time on offense. After the two-score effort, Quitoriano logged double-digit snaps on offense in four straight contests, but he drew just one target over that stretch. In the subsequent two games, Quitoriano has played just three total snaps on offense…

news.headline: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
news.story: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders…

news.headline: Lambert-Smith (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.story: With Ladd McConkey (back) active, Lambert-Smith will be a healthy scratch for Sunday's contest. Lambert-Smith's next opportunity to suit up is Week 12 against the Patriots on Nov. 29, although his path to playing time is limited unless there is an injury in front of him on the Chargers' wide receiver depth chart.

news.headline: Coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Cooper (ankle/hip) will be out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
news.story: Cooper didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday due to a pair of injuries, and he'll wind up sitting out Week 11. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will be the primary wideouts for the Jets, and with Isaiah Williams (ribs) joining Cooper on the sidelines, Malik McClain and Tim Patrick will be options when the team wants to get more receivers on the field, and per head coach Aaron Glenn -- via Rich Cimini of ESPN.com…

news.headline: Cooper didn't practice Thursday due to ankle and hip injuries.
news.story: Cooper made an early exit from this past Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills after injuring his right ankle, and the rookie wideout is also nursing a hip issue as the Jets prepare for a matchup this weekend with the Chargers. With two straight absences from practice to begin the week, Cooper will likely need to get in at least a limited session Friday to have any chance at suiting up Sunday.

news.headline: Cooper (ankle) isn't practicing Wednesday, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
news.story: Cooper logged just one snap this past Sunday against the Bills after tweaking the same ankle he hurt in Week 1, which led to an IR stint. The rookie WR will now have two more chances to practice this week, but if he's sidelined this weekend against the Chargers, Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell would likely be busy in Week 11, with Isaiah Williams (seven targets versus Buffalo) also factoring in.

news.headline: Legette did not play an offensive snap in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: The wide receiver did play nine snaps on special teams. Legette missed six games with a knee injury before returning for Carolina's win over the Saints in Week 10, though he only saw action on two offensive snaps in that contest. Legette has two catches for 64 yards and no touchdowns in four games this season.

news.headline: Legette didn't produce any output in the boxscore during Carolina's win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.story: Legette made his return to the lineup after having been sidelined since Week 2 due to a knee injury, but he ended up playing just two snaps on offense. He will look to be more involved during next week's matchup versus the Ravens.

news.headline: Legette (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
news.story: After being activated from injured reserve Saturday but still being listed as questionable heading into Sunday, Legette has now officially been cleared to play for the first time since Week 2. Legette was a full participant in practice throughout Week 10 prep, so he could immediately step back in as the Panthers' No. 3 wideout, the role he held prior to succumbing to the knee injury.

news.headline: Wayne (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Wayne will miss a second straight game due to a quadriceps injury, and his next chance to suit up is Week 12 against the Jets on Sunday, Nov. 29. In his absence, Kevin Coleman and Jalen Tolbert will serve as the Dolphins' rotational wide receivers behind Malik Washington, Caleb Douglas and Chris Bell.

news.headline: Wayne (quadriceps) did not participate at practice Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Wayne sat out Sunday's game at Indianapolis with a quad injury, and his availability for Week 11 is now in question. If he's not able to get back onto the practice field Thursday or Friday, he'll be trending toward missing Sunday's game at Buffalo.

news.headline: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
news.story: Holani was knocked out of the Seahawks' last game in Week 10 at Las Vegas due to a knee injury that eventually was deemed to be an MCL sprain. Per Brady Henderson of ESPN.com, head coach Mike Macdonald said he was uncertain if Holani will require surgery, but the running back will be sidelined for at least four games by virtue of landing on IR. In the meantime, Emanuel Wilson will serve as the team's No. 3 back…

news.headline: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.
news.story: Holani exited Sunday's Week 10 game against the Raiders after suffering a knee injury. The 26-year-old is not currently expected to be placed on injured reserve, but he will be reevaluated after Seattle's Week 11 bye. The three-year pro has had a larger role on special teams since Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returned from injuries to helm Seattle's ground attack.

news.headline: Holani (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.story: Holani exited the first quarter of Sunday's contest with a knee injury. The running back will not return, leaving another player to fill his special-teams role as Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet continue to dominate the Seahawks' running game.

news.headline: Ahmed reverted to the Bears' practice squad Monday, according to the NFL's official transaction log.
news.story: The running back was elevated from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against New Orleans, and he carried the ball six times for 33 yards across 10 offensive snaps. Ahmed saw action late in the third quarter and into the fourth, after Roschon Johnson exited the game with an ankle injury in the first quarter. Both are behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai on the depth chart.

news.headline: The Bears elevated Ahmed from the practice squad Saturday.
news.story: Even with Kyle Monangai (toe) back from his toe injury for Sunday's game against New Orleans, Ahmed is up as the Bears' fourth running back, though he could be active ahead of Roschon Johnson, who played behind Ahmed in Week 9 against the Bucs.

news.headline: Jefferson failed to haul in his lone target during the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday.
news.story: Jefferson could not hold onto a deep pass from Jayden Daniels early in the fourth quarter, and that catch would have set the Commanders up in the red zone. Jefferson has seen only one pass across his two outings since putting together a 5-58-1 receiving line on seven targets against the Rams in Week 9. Jefferson is firmly entrenched as the Commanders' WR4 behind Stefon Diggs, Antonio Williams and Treylon Burks…

news.headline: Daniels caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) inactive, Daniels' 46 snaps were two fewer than Konata Mumpfield for the team lead at receiver for the Rams. Mumpfield led the group in targets (four), catches (three) and yards (81), and only Xavier Smith (2-40-1) joined him as wide receivers to catch more than one pass from Matthew Stafford against Arizona while the Rams relied heavily on their tight ends…

news.headline: Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
news.story: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this…

news.headline: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
news.story: The wideout had one of his more productive games of the season before being injured, as he caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown. His 40 yards were the second-most he's produced in a game this season. Boutte is up to 21 grabs for 359 yards and three touchdowns on 31 targets across 10 games in 2026.

news.headline: Boutte (hip) was deemed questionable to return to Thursday's Week 11 win over Indianapolis and didn't return to the game.
news.story: The Texans didn't announce Boutte's injury until near the end of the contest when the team's offense was running out the clock. As such, it's difficult to ascertain how serious his hip injury is. The veteran wideout finished the Texans' victory with two catches for 40 yards and a touchdown on two targets, with his score coming on a 24-yard grab in the second quarter. Houston doesn't play again until Sunday, Nov.…

news.headline: Boutte failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.story: Even with Marvin Harrison (hamstring) out and Jaylin Noel (toe) done for the season, Boutte was targeted on just one of C.J. Stroud's 38 pass attempts versus Cleveland. Boutte's 47 snaps on offense were fewer than both Nico Collins (57) and Xavier Hutchinson (51) but 14 more than Tank Dell, though Dell out-targeted Boutte four to one. Boutte popped off for 4-125-2 in Week 9 against the Chargers but otherwise has…

Sturdivant caught two passes for 37 yards and a touchdown on four targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
news.story: After Green Bay was shut out in the first half, Sturdivant's first career touchdown came in the third quarter from 32 yards out, and it went down as the Packers' lone touchdown of the afternoon. Sturdivant played just nine offensive snaps as the fourth receiver and would need more than one injury ahead of him on the depth chart to be relevant in fantasy.

news.headline: Sample caught his lone target for nine yards during the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday.
news.story: After catching a touchdown pass from Joe Burrow in Week 10 against the Steelers, Sample saw only one target from the superstar quarterback during Monday's loss. Sample has caught one pass or zero in seven of 10 regular-season games and has an 11-72-2 receiving line on 12 targets while operating as the Bengals' TE2 behind Mike Gesicki.

news.headline: Sample caught all three of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win against Pittsburgh.
news.story: Sample entered the contest with no catches over his previous two games, but he tied season-high marks in both receptions and targets versus the Steelers. He gave Cincinnati a two-score lead just after the beginning of the second quarter when he hauled in a three-yard TD from Joe Burrow. Sample has two touchdowns over his past four games, but with just five catches for 39 yards during that span, he's almost entirely…

news.headline: Williams failed to haul in his lone target during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: Williams did have a 21-yard carry late in the third quarter, although the play was nullified by offsetting penalties. It was the second straight game that the second-year wide receiver did not record a catch and the fifth time in 10 regular-season contests. New England is on a bye for Week 11, but the offense's outlook looks grim given that franchise quarterback Drake Maye is expected to miss time due to an ankle…

news.headline: Watkins brought in his lone target for 19 yards during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
news.story: Watkins' 28 offensive snaps were tied with Deebo Samuel for second most among 49ers wide receivers behind Keenan Allen (31) and ahead of Mike Evans (23). Watkins has played at least 50 percent of San Francisco's offensive snaps in each of the team's last five games, but the second-year pro is stuck in a complementary role on offense behind Evans, Allen, Samuel, tight end George Kittle and running back Christian…

news.headline: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
news.story: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected…

news.headline: Gilliam (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.
news.story: Gilliam took a questionable tag into Sunday, but the Patriots' decision to activate him from injured reserve Saturday signaled that he was on track to play for the first time since Week 4. The fullback served almost exclusively as a blocker when he was healthy during the Patriots' first four games of the season, logging no carries and recording a four-yard reception on two targets.

news.headline: Horton failed to garner a target during Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.story: Horton failed to reel in a pass for the first time since Week 7, and his 10 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Seattle behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (43), Cooper Kupp (35) and Rashid Shaheed (25). Horton will continue to be an unappealing fantasy option as long as he's buried below the other three wideouts on the depth chart.

news.headline: Hunter caught his lone target for three yards, added a nine-yard carry and logged six tackles (four solo) during the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.story: As has been the case for most of the 2026 season, Hunter spent the majority of his time on the field playing defense, and his six tackles were fourth most on the Jaguars. He had a quiet day offensively, and the second-year pro is up to a 10-94-1 line on 11 targets through 10 regular-season games. On the defensive side of the ball, Hunter is up to 42 tackles (28 solo) and seven pass defenses (including three…

news.headline: Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards, recorded a three-yard carry and contributed five tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.story: Fifty-six of Hunter's 62 snaps Sunday came on defense, and that's where he made his biggest impact with a diving interception on a Cam Ward pass intended for Elic Ayomanor, and the Jaguars offense converted that takeaway into a field goal 10 plays later. Hunter's impact on both sides of the ball has been undeniable: he has 28 catches (on 45 targets) for 298 yards and a touchdown, along with 36 tackles (24 solo) and…

news.headline: Humphrey (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Las Vegas.
news.story: Humphrey will be a healthy scratch for a second consecutive game. His next chance to play is Week 12 against the Steelers on Black Friday, although Humphrey is unlikely to see the field unless a wide receiver ahead of him on the depth chart is not available.

news.headline: Wallace caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Texans. He also recorded one tackle in kick coverage.
news.story: Wallace again played a rotational role in Week 10, logging 13 snaps at wide receiver. He was able to draw a season-high two targets and come down with both of them, making him one of eight Browns to catch a pass from quarterback Deshaun Watson Sunday. Barring an injury to one of the wideouts ahead of him on the depth chart, he doesn't have a clear path to more consistent playing time following Cleveland's bye in…

Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
news.story: The Bengals offense started slowly and was shut out altogether in the first quarter, but Burrow was able to lead his team to 10 second-quarter points partly via a 31-yard touchdown pass to Tee Higgins. The prolific signal-caller added a four-yard scoring toss to Colbie Young in the third quarter, and Burrow then helped lead Cincinnati downfield for a go-ahead Evan McPherson 56-yard field goal with 46 seconds…

news.headline: Gipson was signed by the Giants off of Philadelphia's practice squad Monday, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.
news.story: Gipson will head to New York after spending the entirety of the 2026 campaign to this point on the Eagles' practice squad. The Giants waived primary kick and punt returner Charlie Jones on Monday, and Gipson will likely take over that role beginning in Week 11 against the Jaguars.

news.headline: Ridley caught five of six targets for 68 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Ridley reeled in multiple passes in a contest for the first time since Week 5, and his 12-yard touchdown connection with Cam Ward in the fourth quarter was the wideout's first score of the year. Ridley trailed only fellow wide receiver Chimere Dike (seven) in targets, and Ridley could continue to see added opportunities moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) sidelined for the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

news.headline: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.story: Even though Carnell Tate (shoulder) was sidelined for a second consecutive week, Ridley was barely involved in the Titans' offensive game plan. Ridley's four offensive snaps were by far a season low, and his role figures to shrink even more given that Tate is expected to return for Week 11 against the Cowboys on Nov. 22. Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) could be sidelined for that contest, although those offensive snaps…

news.headline: Shavers failed to bring in either of his two targets and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Bills' 26-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.story: Shavers played 27 offensive snaps and 16 special-teams in his return to the field Sunday. The wide receiver has finally started to mix into the offense after recovering from the torn ACL he suffered in the Bills' 27-24 wild-card win over the Jaguars last January.

news.headline: Shavers (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Shavers was activated from the reserve/PUP list Saturday, and the San Diego State product has been officially cleared to play Sunday in what will be his first game since the Bills AFC wild-card round win over the Jaguars in January, when he tore his ACL. Shavers will likely operate in a rotational role on offense behind DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman.

news.headline: Bills head coach Joe Brady said Wednesday that Shavers (knee) has been reinstated from the PUP list, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.
news.story: Shavers' 21-day evaluation window was set to close this week, so the Bills elected to add him back to the 53-man roster to ensure that he would be available to play this season. The wideout has been a full practice participant for the past two weeks, so he appears to be fully recovered from the torn ACL he sustained in January and should be available for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. If active for the Week 11…

news.headline: The Colts ruled out Mallory (hamstring) for Thursday night's games against the Texans.
news.story: Mallory was absent from practice all week heading into Thursday night's divisional showdown versus Houston. This marks the 27-year-old's third straight missed game. He has caught two of nine targets for 20 yards in three games during the 2026 season.

news.headline: Mallory (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant for Tuesday's practice walkthrough.
news.story: Tuesday was the second straight day that the Colts held a walkthrough instead of a traditional practice, and Mallory was deemed a DNP in both cases. It's looking increasingly unlikely that the tight end will be able to play Thursday versus Houston, though he could give himself a chance to suit up if he's able to show improvement over the next day. Should Mallory be out Thursday, Drew Ogletree and Pharaoh Brown…

news.headline: Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Mallory suffered a hamstring injury during Week 10 prep, and he was not cleared to play in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. Indianapolis is operating on a short week, so Mallory faces an uphill battle to play against the Texans on Thursday.

news.headline: Williams (ribs) won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.story: With Omar Cooper (ankle/hip) also slated to be unavailable for the contest, Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will lead the Jets' Week 11 WR corps, with coach Aaron Glenn noting Friday that the team's tight ends, primarily Kenyon Sadiq and Mason Taylor, should have an opportunity to see added opportunities as pass catchers this weekend in the absence of both Cooper and Williams.

news.headline: Williams (ribs) was a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
news.story: The Jets' wideout depth could be tested in Sunday's game against the Chargers, as both Williams and Omar Cooper (ankle/hip) have been sidelined for the team's first two Week 11 practices. Both receivers will likely need to practice in some fashion Friday to avoid being ruled out ahead of the weekend. If neither Williams nor Cooper can suit up against the Chargers, Malik McClain and Tim Patrick would be the…

news.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Williams won't practice Wednesday due to a rib injury, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.
news.story: New York will be without two of its wideouts to begin Week 11 prep, as rookie Omar Cooper (ankle) is also sidelined for Wednesday's practice. Williams drew a season-high seven targets in this past Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills, finishing with four catches for 24 yards across 50 offensive snaps while apparently picking up an injury at some point along the way.

news.headline: Week 11 winners and losers: Cowboys put up points while Josh Allen does not
Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.story: Goff put together an efficient effort on an afternoon when he recorded completions to eight different targets. The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff boasts a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

news.headline: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.
news.story: A potential barn burner versus Drake Maye never materialized when the New England quarterback left the game early with an ankle injury, but Goff and the Detroit offense still held up their end of the bargain. Two of Goff's TDs went to Amon-Ra St. Brown, including a 56-yard catch-and-run score in the first quarter, while Isaac TeSlaa also hauled in a 12-yard score in the second. Goff will take an 18:4 TD:INT through…

news.headline: Patrick (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bills.
news.story: Garrett Wilson (concussion), Omar Cooper (ankle) and Adonai Mitchell (knee) have all been cleared to play Sunday, so Patrick will observe from the sidelines. Patrick hasn't played since Week 7 against the Dolphins, and his next opportunity to suit up is Week 11 against the Chargers on Nov. 22.

news.headline: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.
news.story: Young suffered a stinger late in the first half, and his availability for the rest of the game is now in question. In his absence, Cody White is a candidate to see a slight uptick in opportunities on offense with Las Vegas.

news.headline: Young went without a target while playing one of the Raiders' 59 snaps on offense in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks. He also brought back one kickoff for 29 yards.
news.story: Young has suited up in each of the Raiders' 10 games this season, but he's been deployed almost exclusively on special teams. He's seen single-digit snaps on offense in five straight games and has posted a collective 2-36-0 receiving line on three targets on the campaign.

news.headline: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: After a quiet first half, Gordon got free for a 24-yard run on the first possession of the second half to set up Miami's third and final field goal of the afternoon. Gordon was Miami's most effective offensive player as usual, as Kyle McCord threw for just 102 yards in the latter's second NFL start. This was Gordon's seventh consecutive game with at least 64 scrimmage yards, but he'll take a four-game touchdown…

news.headline: Fantasy football matchup ranks: Upgrade Jonah Coleman, downgrade Brock Purdy
Gordon rushed 20 times for 76 and brought in four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.story: Filling his customary workhorse role in Miami's ground attack, Gordon handled all but four of the Dolphins' running back carries while finishing with a team-high reception total. The second-year back eclipsed 75 rushing yards for the fourth time in six games in the process, and Gordon's catch and receiving yardage totals were also season highs. Gordon should remain in a high-volume role in a Week 11 road matchup…

news.headline: Allen caught his lone target for a 19-yard touchdown in Sunday's win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With all three of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), Davante Adams (hamstring) and Terrance Ferguson (hamstring) out, the Rams leaned on their tight-end triumvirate of Tyler Higbee, Colby Parkinson and Allen, as all three played more offensive snaps than any of the Los Angeles wideouts. Parkinson (53 snaps) led the way, followed by Allen (52) and Higbee (51), and both Allen and Higbee caught touchdowns. Allen, however, ran…

news.headline: Allen (oblique) is active for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.story: Allen has recovered enough from the oblique injury he suffered during the Rams' Week 9 win over the Commanders to suit up for Week 10. The No. 3 tight end is a key part of the Rams' 13-personnel offense, and he should continue seeing a significant share of offensive snaps for the team.

news.headline: Turpin failed to reel in his only target while rushing twice for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans. He added 121 yards as a kick returner and logged a 13-yard punt return.
news.story: Turpin went without a catch for the fourth time this season, but he was able to make his mark as a rusher in Week 11. The wideout was able to break loose for a 22-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, notching his second score on the ground this season. Turpin has now caught five of 11 targets for 49 yards, rushed five times for 60 yards and two touchdowns, and added 695 kick-return yards and 121 yards as a…

news.headline: Turpin is expected to resume return duties on both kickoffs and punts Sunday against the Titans, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.
news.story: The wide receiver had to sit for three games with a rib injury before coming back for last Sunday's loss to the 49ers, in which he fielded punts but not kickoffs. Turpin has 574 kickoff-return yards and 108 punt-return yards on the year.

news.headline: Turpin caught one of three targets for 10 yards Sunday in a Week 10 loss to San Francisco. He also rushed once for nine yards.
news.story: Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times in the offensive slugfest, but Turpin got only three of his targets. Meanwhile, George Pickens drew a whopping 18 looks, CeeDee Lamb got 13 and Ryan Flournoy got seven, and all three of those wideouts scored at least one touchdown. Turpin logged a 17 percent offensive snap share in his return from a three-game absence caused by an injury to his ribs. He's fallen below a 20…

news.headline: Fantasy football trade deadline: 7 players to trade for, 5 to trade away
Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Jefferson has experienced an uptick in usage since the Vikings reacquired Kirk Cousins. The star WR has 16 catches for 160 yards on 22 targets in two games with Cousins, though Jefferson hasn't scored since Week 8. Jefferson fumbled at the end of a 25-yard catch in the third quarter, turning what would have been one of his best plays of the night into a lowlight. Another heavy dose of targets from Cousins likely…

news.headline: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: In Kirk Cousins' return to the Vikings, Jefferson led the team in catches, targets and receiving yards, although Myles Price and Gavin Bartholomew were on the other end of the QB's two touchdown passes. The nine grabs and 13 targets were season highs for Jefferson, while the yardage total was his best showing since Week 5. Despite a disappointing 40-467-4 line on 64 targets through eight games, the star wideout's…

news.headline: Klein secured all four targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Klein surprisingly outpaced veteran position mates Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau on the night, and the rookie second-round pick, whose only other career reception coming in was a 16-yard grab in Week 1, added his first career touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the third quarter. Given Klein had been a complete non-factor coming into the night, it's difficult to predict whether Thursday's production will have any…

news.headline: Watkins brought in his lone target for 19 yards during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
news.story: Watkins' 28 offensive snaps were tied with Deebo Samuel for second most among 49ers wide receivers behind Keenan Allen (31) and ahead of Mike Evans (23). Watkins has played at least 50 percent of San Francisco's offensive snaps in each of the team's last five games, but the second-year pro is stuck in a complementary role on offense behind Evans, Allen, Samuel, tight end George Kittle and running back Christian…

news.headline: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
news.story: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected…

news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in…

news.headline: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
news.story: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the…

news.headline: The Eagles listed Barkley (neck/illness) as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Though Tuesday's injury report was merely an estimate, Barkley would have been able to take every rep had the Eagles held a traditional practice session. Barkley emerged from this past Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers with a neck injury and an illness, but neither health concern looks like it will prevent him from playing Thursday in Dallas.

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.
news.story: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team…

news.headline: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks,…

news.headline: Bryant returned to Sunday's game against the Raiders after making a brief visit to the sideline tent, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
news.story: Bryant's time away from the field occurred in the middle of the third quarter. He'll look to build upon the 3-32-0 line on three targets that he accrued to that point in the contest.

news.headline: What to know to set your lineup: Nix, Ward viable options if your QB is on bye
Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.story: Wetjen has operated as the Steelers' top returner on both kickoffs and punts this season. However, with Roman Wilson back from injured reserve and Max Hurleman elevated from the practice squad to the active roster, Wetjen will be a healthy scratch Sunday for the first time this season. Wetjen's next opportunity to play is Friday against the Broncos, although the rookie fourth-rounder's chances of suiting up for…

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Douglas caught two of 10 targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: Douglas paced the team in targets and receiving yards, but he struggled to get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who completed just 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards. The rookie WR didn't help his cause with a red-zone drop in the third quarter. In Week 12, Douglas will face a Jets secondary against which he scored twice in their Week 7 matchup. Those are the only two touchdowns of his seven-game regular-season career.

news.headline: Douglas (shoulder) will play Sunday against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Douglas was managed during the practice week, but he's good to go for his normal every-down role Sunday against Buffalo. With the Dolphins installed as 16.5-point underdogs, Miami is projected to throw a ton in comeback mode. However, Douglas is a tough click for fantasy with Kyle McCord under center.

news.headline: Benson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.story: Benson is a healthy scratch for a third consecutive week. The rookie sixth-rounder has failed to find a place in a wide-open receiving corps so far, and it remains to be seen how coach Klint Kubiak will utilize him.

news.headline: LaPorta (ankle) was a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Now that he's gotten a full practice under his belt this week, LaPorta should be in the clear for Thursday's game against the Bears. The fourth-year tight end is coming off a three-catch, 62-yard performance on six targets in a 31-21 win over the Buccaneers this past Sunday, with the yardage and target totals both representing his highest marks since the Lions' Week 6 bye.

news.headline: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
news.story: With a Thanksgiving matchup on tap against the Bears, the Lions are easing into the week following Sunday's 31-21 win against the Buccaneers, when LaPorta gathered in three of six targets for 62 yards. He's nursing an ankle issue in the wake of that contest, and he may need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Thursday's game.

news.headline: LaPorta brought in three of six targets for 62 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.story: LaPorta helped set the tone for the Lions early with an impressive 47-yard catch and run down the middle of the field on Detroit's second play from scrimmage. The yardage total was the talented tight end's highest since Week 5, and it enabled him to finish second on the day for the Lions in that category behind Jameson Williams. LaPorta now boasts a 39-477-3 line on 59 targets heading into Thursday's Thanksgiving…

news.headline: Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
news.story: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this…

news.headline: Davis didn't play an offensive snap in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: As has been the case for three straight weeks, with Breece Hall back healthy, Davis has been glued to special teams for the Jets. He has no fantasy appeal.

news.headline: Davis didn't touch the ball on offense in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.story: With Breece Hall and Braelon Allen both healthy, Davis has minimal fantasy value, except for leagues that count return yardage. He's played zero offensive snaps over the last two contests, but Davis did return three kickoffs for 74 yards against Buffalo.

news.headline: Larison turned his lone carry into two yards and caught two of three targets for 15 yards and a touchdown during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle on special teams.
news.story: The Patriots lost starting quarterback Drake Maye to an ankle injury early in the first quarter, so backup Tommy DeVito was under center for most of contest. New England struggled with DeVito at the helm, but he did connect with Larison for a 10-yard touchdown pass early in the fourth quarter in what was the Patriots' lone trip to the end zone. Even though that score came in garbage time, it was the first touchdown…

news.headline: Cowing returned one punt for no gain during San Francisco's win over the Vikings on Sunday.
news.story: Cowing saw limited action in the win, playing just six snaps on offense and two on special teams. The 25-year-old hasn't been targeted across the last two games and should continue to serve a depth role with Mike Evans now healthy.

news.headline: Cowing did not draw any targets during Sunday's 46-40 win at Dallas.
news.story: Cowing was also sent back to receive two punts in Week 10, making a fair catch on one and allowing the other to go into the endzone for a touchback. He has now drawn just one target over the two games following his three-catch performance in Week 7, and his role in the 49ers' offense figures to shrink even further once veteran Mike Evans returns from Achilles tendinitis, which could happen as soon as Sunday versus…

news.headline: Blue returned his lone kickoff for 23 yards but fumbled the ball in the process during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: The loose ball was recovered by the Steelers, and Pittsburgh's offense turned that takeaway into a 40-yard field goal by Chris Boswell four plays later. It ended up being the only touch of the game for Blue, who played all 11 of his snaps on special teams. There's an outside chance he sees some involvement on offense against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day, but that will depend on the availability of both Saquon…

news.headline: The Eagles signed Blue from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
news.story: It's already the third time this season Blue has been signed by Philadelphia from the practice squad to the active roster. The second-year pro has seen action in two games with the club, recording a nine-yard catch on his only touch while racking up 268 yards on 12 kickoff returns. Blue is currently the only healthy running back on the Eagles' active roster aside from starter Saquon Barkley, but that may change…

news.headline: Blue was signed to the Eagles' practice squad Monday.
news.story: Blue was let go by the Eagles after suiting up for the team in Weeks 8 and 9, a span in which he didn't record a carry and caught his only target for nine yards. Now that he's back on the team's practice squad, the 2025 fifth-rounder will give Philadelphia's Saquon Barkley-led RB corps an added depth option ahead of Week 11 action.

news.headline: Virgil wasn't targeted in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: The 22-year-old wide receiver played just two offensive snaps, the same amount as Devin Duvernay, as the duo played behind all three of Simi Fehoko (52 snaps), Harrison Wallace (36) and Zay Jones (32) in the Cardinals' injury-ravaged wideout depth chart. Virgil has three catches for 54 yards on 11 targets across seven games this season and therefore doesn't possess any fantasy relevance at the moment.

news.headline: Virgil was on the field for 16 of the Cardinals' 35 offensive snaps (45.7 percent), but the rookie fifth-rounder didn't get a target during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
news.story: The Cardinals' offense struggled in its first game this season with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck under center, finishing with just 17:37 in time of possession. That meant less opportunities for Virgil and the rest of the pass catchers, and even star tight end Trey McBride finished with only five catches on as many targets for 37 yards. It's hard to put much trust into Virgil and the rest of the pass catchers,…

news.headline: Stafford completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Stafford didn't let the fact he was without top wideouts Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) deter him from a very fantasy-friendly performance, as the reigning NFL MVP tossed at least three TD passes for the fourth time this season. Stafford connected with the unlikely trio of Tyler Higbee (five yards), Xavier Smith (22 yards) and Davis Allen (19 yards) for his scoring strikes, and the…

The reasons Dopp is picking Dak Prescott over Patrick Mahomes in Week 12
