The Chiefs placed VanSumeren (knee) on the reserve/injured list Tuesday.
news.story: VanSumeren didn't practice Tuesday due to a sprained knee that will now keep him out for at least the next four weeks, according to Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site. In six regular-season games in 2026, the fourth-year pro played a majority of his reps on special teams, with just six of 104 total snaps coming on offense.

news.headline: VanSumeren (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.story: VanSumeran injured his knee in the second half, and with no other fullback on the 53-man roster, the Chiefs could turn to tight end Jake Briningstool to provide additional blocking out of the backfield. VanSumeran's status over the coming days will be worth monitoring, given that the Chiefs are operating on a short week and play against the Bills on Thanksgiving Day.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Grab your Rams and Packers quickly
Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
news.story: Freiermuth matched his season high in catches, securing five passes in a game for the third time this year. The tight end has yet to exceed 50 receiving yards in a contest this season, and he entered Week 11 with exactly two catches in each of the team's last four games. Freiermuth has now caught 32 of 43 targets for 309 yards and five touchdowns while also adding four rushes for five yards and a score over 10…

news.headline: Freiermuth recorded two catches (on three targets) for 35 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-18 loss in Cincinnati.
news.story: Freiermuth was added to the Steelers' injury report Saturday due to an illness that left him questionable for Week 10 action. Ultimately, he avoided inactive status and also made an end-zone visit for the first time since Week 5 on a 27-yard hookup with QB Aaron Rodgers in the fourth quarter. Considering Freiermuth hasn't reached 50 receiving yards in any game this season, he remains a TD-dependent fantasy option…

news.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Coleman surges among RBs, Taylor sinks
Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Fantasy football trade deadline: 7 players to trade for, 5 to trade away
Wease was waived by the Chargers on Tuesday.
news.story: Wease was signed to the active roster with Los Angeles on Oct. 10, and he caught three of five targets for 37 yards while appearing in four contests with the team before being let go Tuesday. The wide receiver will likely land on the Chargers' practice squad.

news.headline: Laube played all 22 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks and returned two kickoffs for 46 yards and one punt for zero yards.
news.story: Since earning seven touches in a Week 5 blowout loss to the Patriots, Laube has been an afterthought on offense. He's played just eight total offense snaps in the Raiders' ensuing five games, and Sunday marked the first time all season that he was limited exclusively to special teams.

news.headline: Ali played all 19 of his snaps on special teams in Monday's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
news.story: For the second week in a row, Ali was deployed exclusively on special teams while the Ravens leaned on Derrick Henry and Justice Hill to handle all the snaps out of the backfield. Ali has logged just seven total snaps on offense all season, carrying six times for 24 yards.

news.headline: Restrepo caught his lone target for five yards in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Even with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) out, Restrepo played as the Titans' WR5 against Dallas, as his 17 offensive snaps trailed all four of Carnell Tate (61), Chimere Dike (53), Elic Ayomanor (36) and Calvin Ridley (26). Restrepo played 11 of his 13 snaps in the slot, where Robinson operated prior to his injury, but it was actually Dike and Daniel Bellinger who saw the biggest boosts in slot rate with Robinson out.

news.headline: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.
news.story: A 2025 undrafted free agent who played alongside Cam Ward during their final collegiate seasons at Miami, Restrepo showed immediate chemistry with the Titans' second-year quarterback during a 40-23 loss to the Jaguars in Week 10. Restrepo went on to play 19 snaps following Robinson's exit late in the third quarter and notched three receptions for 31 yards on three targets over the game's final 10 minutes. While the…

news.headline: Restrepo was signed to the Titans' active roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.
news.story: Restrepo was elevated to the active roster in Week 10 against the Jaguars, and he reeled in all three of his targets for 31 yards over 19 offensive snaps. After fellow wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Restrepo will replace him on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cowboys.

news.headline: Mingo (ankle) did not participate in practice Tuesday.
news.story: Mingo downgraded from his limited participation in Monday's practice to full DNP Tuesday. The 25-year-old missed the last two games due to an ankle injury and could be in danger of missing Thursday's divisional game against the Eagles if he doesn't upgrade his practice status Wednesday. KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown have been rotational options at wide receiver in Mingo's absence.

news.headline: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: It will be the second game that Mingo will miss while recovering from foot and ankle injuries, which have prevented him from practicing over the last two weeks, and his next chance to suit up is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day. In Mingo's absence, KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown will be the Cowboys' rotational options at wide receiver behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Ryan Flournoy.

news.headline: Trevor Lawrence dimes Brian Thomas Jr. for a Jags TD
Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Thomas' three targets were a distant fourth on the team, as Parker Washington (17), Jakobi Meyers (10) and Josh Cameron (seven) combined to see a combined 34 looks on Trevor Lawrence's 47 pass attempts. Thomas ran 32 routes, 14 more than Cameron as the Jaguars' nominal WR3, but the former hasn't been seeing meaningful target volume for months. After drawing nine targets in Week 2, Thomas has averaged 2.1 targets…

news.headline: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
news.story: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three…

news.headline: Cameron caught three of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss against the Giants. He also returned two kickoffs for a total of 40 yards.
news.story: Despite being on the field for only 25 of the Jaguars' 68 offensive snaps in Week 11, Cameron drew a career-high seven targets. He wasn't terribly efficient on those targets, but neither was Jacksonville's offense as a whole Sunday. He'll be lining up against a much softer pass defense in a Week 12 tilt versus the Titans.

news.headline: Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23, Week 10 win over Tennessee. He also returned five kickoffs for 142 yards.
news.story: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. news.headline: Bell (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Bell made his third appearance of the 2026 campaign in Week 10, though he went without a catch. With Tyrell Shavers (knee) cleared to play for Sunday's divisional clash with Miami after spending time on injured reserve, Bell's services won't be needed. His next opportunity to play will come in Week 12 against the Chiefs.

news.story: Price played 10 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver was targeted on 20 percent of his reps, making the most of his offensive opportunities as the No. 5 option. Price continues to show out on special teams, with 912 kickoff-return yards and 281 punt-return yards over 10 games so far in 2026.

news.headline: Price is set for an increase in offensive workload with Jordan Addison (thumb) sidelined, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Price reeled in a season-high four passes for 49 yards and a score during Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. Addison now is expected to undergo thumb surgery, opening the door for Price to operate in an elevated…

news.headline: Price caught all four targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: With Jordan Addison (thumb) inactive, Price moved up the depth chart and played 33 of 69 offensive snaps behind Justin Jefferson (63) and Tai Felton (59) in Kirk Cousins' 2026 debut with the team. Price ended up running 22 routes on Cousins' 36 dropbacks and produced the game's first touchdown, scoring from 38 yards out in the first quarter to give Minnesota a 10-0 lead. news.headline: Wallace finished Sunday's loss to Kansas City with four catches for 57 yards on seven targets.
news.story: Wallace began the season on the Cardinals' practice squad and didn't play in his first NFL game until Week 9 versus Seattle. After logging a total of seven offensive snaps and one catch across his first two contests, the rookie paced Arizona wideouts in targets, receptions and receiving yards. news.story: Though he played just five of the Cardinals' 35 snaps on offense, Wallace was able to come away with his first NFL reception in the third quarter. Even if Wallace earns more playing time in future weeks, he'll likely struggle to produce meaningful fantasy lines while rookie third-round pick Carson Beck continues to direct the offense behind a shaky offensive line.

news.headline: Adkins recorded a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: Adkins was on the field for 30 of the Broncos' 73 snaps on offense, with his 41 percent share representing a season-high mark. The fourth-year tight end out of South Carolina has mainly served as a blocking specialist for Denver, having thus far been limited to a 7-47-3 receiving line on nine targets to go with a six-yard carry through 10 appearances on the season.

news.headline: Herbert caught two of his three targets for seven yards during Sunday's 35-13 loss versus the Chiefs. He also returned six kickoffs for 168 yards.
news.story: Herbert was targeted three times for the second straight game in Week 10, but he continued to make a bigger impact on special teams. His first kickoff return of the day went for 39 yards to Atlanta's 45-yard line, but the offense promptly went three and out. He'll be hoping to keep up the momentum as a returner following the Falcons' bye in Week 11.

news.story: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. news.headline: Smith (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.story: Smith dealt with an ankle injury during the week after he was forced from last Sunday's loss against the Bills, but all scans came back clean, and the veteran quarterback is good to go for a road date in Los Angeles. Smith has been able to get the ball to his playmakers this season, but he doesn't have any fantasy upside as a statuesque pocket passer in an offense that likes to run the ball.

news.story: Endries reeled in a career-high four passes while playing 15 snaps on offense in Week 11. The rookie is still behind Mike Gesicki and Drew Sample in the pecking order at tight end ahead of Week 12 versus the Saints.

news.story: Though quarterback Trevor Lawrence dropped back a season-high 50 times on the day and targeted nine different players, Boerkircher wasn't able to earn a look in the passing game. Mayfield's rushing yardage total was also a new season high, and he'll next take aim at the…

news.headline: Mayfield (foot/thumb) is listed as active Sunday at Detroit, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
news.story: With the Buccaneers on bye in Week 10, Mayfield was front and center following a report from Mike Garafolo of NFL Network last Sunday that the quarterback's status for Week 11 was up in the air due to a foot injury. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network then reported Tuesday that Mayfield "seems to be trending" toward missing Sunday's game. Mayfield then followed up Wednesday's DNP with limited practices Thursday and Friday,…

news.headline: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.story: Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. Trevor Etienne, Anthony Tyus and AJ Dillon will continue to operate as the Panthers' backfield depth options behind Chuba Hubbard in the absence of…

news.headline: Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Brooks remains on injured reserve, so the questionable tag suggests Carolina at least may activate him ahead of Sunday's contest. If he's cleared to play, the running back would be in line to make his first appearance since Week 2, though he's no real threat to Chuba Hubbard's standing as the Panthers' lead back.

news.headline: Brooks (groin) remained a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Brooks is still on injured reserve but appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Baltimore on Sunday. Chuba Hubbard should remain head-and-shoulders above Brooks on the depth chart as the clear RB1 for Carolina, but the Panthers likely also want to use the rest of the season to see if Brooks can stay healthy for a stretch and produce when given opportunities. Brooks is worth adding in fantasy, but his…

news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in…

news.headline: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
news.story: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the…

news.headline: Cooper caught four of his five targets for 59 yards in the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: Cooper played 46 offensive snaps and 15 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver continues to see a significant snap share for the Eagles, drawing two more targets than rookie first-round pick Makai Lemon in the Week 11 win.

news.headline: Prentice (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: It appears Prentice entered the league's concussion protocol following the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers. He had additional time to recover courtesy of the Week 10 bye, so the veteran fullback should be available for Sunday's AFC West tilt against the Raiders.

news.headline: Bartholomew caught one of three targets for five yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: With T.J. Hockenson back in the lineup after being inactive Week 10, Bartholomew played just 18 of 67 offensive snaps as the Vikings' third tight end, also behind Ben Yurosek. Bartholomew has 11 catches for 95 yards and a touchdown on 15 targets across 10 games this season.

news.headline: Bartholomew should revert to a backup role with T.J. Hockenson returning from a wrist injury for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
news.story: Bartholomew was targeted four times in Week 10 for three catches, 36 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers. The tight end received more than one target in only one other game this season, Week 5, when Hockenson went down after two offensive snaps. While Bartholomew has proven himself a red-zone threat, Hockenson should return to seeing most of the tight end volume in Sunday's contest.

news.headline: Bartholomew caught three of four targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: With T.J. Hockenson (wrist) inactive, Bartholomew played 53 of 69 offensive snaps against Green Bay and caught the second of Kirk Cousins' two touchdowns, scoring from 20 yards out in the fourth quarter to give Minnesota a comfortable 27-10 lead. While Ben Yurosek got the start, Bartholomew played 13 more snaps and out-targeted Yurosek four to one. Cousins has an affinity for throwing to his tight ends, so…

news.headline: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
news.story: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the…

news.headline: Brooks carried three times for 12 yards while taking the field for three of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
news.story: All three of Brooks' carries came during the Bengals' final possession of the fourth quarter, when the team had already built a sizable lead and opted to rest multiple key players, including top running back Chase Brown. Brooks has been active for all nine of the Bengals' games to date but has logged just six carries, all of which have come late in blowout victories. So long as Brown and Samaje Perine are both…

news.headline: The Eagles listed Barkley (neck/illness) as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Though Tuesday's injury report was merely an estimate, Barkley would have been able to take every rep had the Eagles held a traditional practice session. Barkley emerged from this past Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers with a neck injury and an illness, but neither health concern looks like it will prevent him from playing Thursday in Dallas.

news.headline: Mason rushed 11 times for 38 yards while catching his lone target for minus-1 yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Mason had one more carry and eight more rushing yards than Aaron Jones, but Jones' totals included an 11-yard touchdown run in the first quarter. They have worked in a near-even split when both veteran RBs have been healthy, but Mason hasn't scored since Week 1. Between his lack of TDs and minimal involvement as a pass catcher (three receptions for six yards in six games), Mason hasn't provided much fantasy value…

news.headline: Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: The fifth-year RB led the Vikings in rushing yards, but Aaron Jones was the more productive player in the backfield, gaining 55 scrimmage yards on 12 touches and scoring on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. news.story: Bell saw 34 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest but was inefficient with his opportunities. The Dolphins continues to try to involve the third-round rookie, but he's been frequently out of sync with quarterbacks Malik Willis (IR, abdomen) and Kyle McCord.

news.headline: Bell (chest) has returned to Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
news.story: Bell suffered a chest injury late in the first half and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, the rookie wideout got back into the game shortly after halftime. Bell will look to be more productive after finishing the first half without a reception.

news.headline: Bell suffered a chest injury during Sunday's game at Buffalo.
news.story: Bell took a big hit to the chest on QB Kyle McCord's interception with 18 seconds remaining in the first half, remaining on the turf for a spell before making his way to the sideline under his own power. He had no catches on his three targets at the time of his exit.

news.story: Corley had not caught a pass across the first nine games of the campaign before hauling in three passes during Sunday's victory. He ended up finishing the contest third on the team in receiving yards behind Harold Fannin and Jerry Jeudy.

The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff boasts a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

Two of Goff's TDs went to Amon-Ra St. Brown, including a 56-yard catch-and-run score in the first quarter, while Isaac TeSlaa also hauled in a 12-yard score in the second. news.story: Freiermuth was added to the Steelers' injury report Saturday due to an illness that left him questionable for Week 10 action. Ultimately, he avoided inactive status and also made an end-zone visit for the first time since Week 5 on a 27-yard hookup with QB Aaron Rodgers in the fourth quarter. Considering Freiermuth hasn't reached 50 receiving yards in any game this season, he remains a TD-dependent fantasy option…

news.headline: Allen logged 80 kickoff-return yards in the Dolphins' 26-9 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.story: Allen played 16 special-teams snaps in the contest. The running back did not log an offensive snap, leaving all the rushing work to Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright.

news.headline: Allen turned his lone carry into zero yards and hauled in his lone target for minus-4 yards during the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.story: Allen found the ball on both of his offensive snaps during Sunday's loss, although he ended up losing four yards on his only catch of the game early in the second quarter. He's well behind Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright on the running back depth chart, and most of Allen's playing time in Week 11 against the Bills on Nov. 22, likely will come on special teams.

news.headline: Higbee caught three of four targets for 17 yards and a touchdown during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Higbee's third and final catch of Sunday's game came late in the second quarter, with the veteran tight end connecting with Matthew Stafford for a five-yard touchdown to give the Rams a 10-6 lead. It was the second touchdown of the season for Higbee, with his first taking place in Week 3 against the Broncos. He's been held to three catches or fewer in each of his last four games, although he's been on the field for…

news.headline: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.
news.story: Though he's been active for five straight games while the Commanders' receiving depth has taken hits due to season-ending injuries to Terry McLaurin (knee) and Jaylin Lane (ankle), McCaffrey has yet to carve out much of a role on offense. He took the field for a season-high 14 of the Commanders' 69 offensive plays in Week 10 but went without a target. McCaffrey is likely to continue to provide his greatest impact…

news.story: The tight end earned just a 9.1 percent target share and continues to be nearly invisible in the box score despite being an every-down player who runs virtually every pass route for the Bucs. Otton has just one touchdown since Week 11 of the 2024 season and has just one career 100-yard receiving game across 73 regular-season contests. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet who clearly busts far more than he hits.

news.headline: Dulin caught two of his four targets for 30 yards and assisted on two tackles on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
news.story: Dulin played 22 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in the contest. The No. 4 wide receiver saw plenty of attention, catching 50 percent of his targets to accumulate the second-highest receiving yardage for the Colts, behind Anthony Gould's 48 yards.

news.headline: Dulin caught one of two targets for 30 yards and returned three kickoffs for 77 yards during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded two tackles on special teams.
news.story: Even with Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being sent out at the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Dulin's 13 offensive snaps were fourth-most among Colts wide receivers behind Laquon Treadwell (52), Deion Burks (34) and Anthony Gould (32). Dulin did connect on a 30-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the second quarter, which was a pivotal part of a nine-play, 92-yard drive that ended with a seven-yard touchdown catch by…

news.story: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. Allen remains the more efficient runner, averaging 5.0 yards per carry to Hall's 3.4 this season, but Hall is the team's preferred option in passing situations, which have been plentiful with the 2-8 Jets frequently in catch-up mode. Perhaps a Week 11 matchup with a Chargers team that's still searching…

Davis has handled 17 carries across 10 games this season, turning them into a measly 55 yards and no touchdowns. His only fantasy value is being Cook's backup.

news.headline: Davis (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: The backup running back was managed during the practice week but is good to go for his normal role behind lead back James Cook. With the Bills listed as 16.5-point favorites, Davis could see some extra reps in garbage time if Buffalo does indeed blow out Miami.

news.headline: Davis (hamstring) remained limited in Thursday's practice.
news.story: It's a new injury for the running back, which clouds his status for Week 11 against the Dolphins. If Davis is unable to handle his normal handful of snaps, Frank Gore could be elevated from the practice squad.

news.story: After the Bengals had built a 20-point lead with five minutes remaining in the fourth quarter, head coach Mike McCarthy opted to remove starting quarterback Aaron Rodgers from the game and turned to Rudolph to direct the offense for the Steelers' final possession. news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.

news.story: Melton was injured in the Packers' Week 10 loss to the Vikings and has been limited in practice each of the last two days leading up to Wednesday's game against the Rams. The wide receiver has appeared in all 10 games this season, recording five catches for 34 yards on 10 targets across 150 offensive snaps.

news.headline: Melton (thigh) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Melton's practice reps Sunday were limited due to a thigh injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the Vikings. His practice participation over the coming days will shed light on his chances of playing Wednesday against the Rams.

news.headline: Ott logged five rushing attempts for 12 yards and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Ott logged 12 offensive snaps and eight special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The running back saw a few carries behind Emmett Johnson due to the absence of Kenneth Walker (groin). With Walker likely returning for Thursday night's game against the Bills, Ott may not see the field on offense in that contest.

news.headline: Ott (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: Ott was unable to play against the Falcons in Week 10 due to a hamstring injury. However, the undrafted rookie out of Oklahoma was cleared to practice in full Wednesday, so he should be available for Sunday's home game against the Cardinals. If Kenneth Walker (groin) cannot play in Week 11, then Ott would have the opportunity to serve as the Chiefs' RB2 behind rookie fifth-rounder Emmett Johnson.

news.headline: Ott (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.
news.story: Ott drew the questionable tag for Week 10 after popping up on Thursday's practice report as a limited participant due to a hamstring injury. The injury is severe enough for him to miss Sunday's game, and his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Cardinals on Nov. 22. With both Ott and Kenneth Walker (groin) sidelined, the Chiefs' backfield will be led by rookie fifth-rounder Emmett Johnson, while Nate…

news.headline: Zaccheaus caught two of his four targets for 17 yards and returned five punts for 81 yards during Atlanta's loss Sunday versus the Chiefs.
news.story: Zaccheaus recorded a season-high 17 receiving yards during the loss while playing 29 snaps on offense and 14 on special teams. The 29-year-old has hauled in eight passes for 43 yards in addition to amassing 231 kick-return yards and 81 punt-return yards across nine games this season.

The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The…
news.story: Nacua is expected to miss "a couple of months" after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, per Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com. With Nacua and Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) sidelined for Week 10 against the Cardinals, Mumpfield operated as the Rams' WR1 for that contest and finished with three catches (on four targets) for 81 yards in a 34-6 win for Los Angeles. The Rams are "hopeful" that Adams will return soon,…

news.headline: Allen caught one pass for minus-1 yard in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.story: Allen played 14 offensive snaps behind Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez, and Tuten ended up aggravating his ankle issue in the defeat. If Tuten needs to miss time, Allen could see elevated snaps behind Rodriguez, though Ameer Abdullah also is an option for the Jaguars out of the backfield. Ultimately, Allen is much likelier than not to remain irrelevant in fantasy.

news.headline: Allen (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.story: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.

news.headline: Allen (hamstring) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
news.story: Allen is one of three Jaguars running backs on the Week 11 injury report, with Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez (hand) also tending to health concerns. After being listed as a non-participant Thursday, Tuten appears to be more at risk of sitting out Sunday against the Giants than either Allen or Rodriguez, both of whom have been limited in the Jaguars' first two Week 11 practices.

news.headline: Mims caught one of two targets for 36 yards and also added an 11-yard rush and 22 yards as a punt returner during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: Mims reeled in just one pass for the second straight game, but his 36-yard snag in the second quarter was enough to notch his second-highest receiving yardage total in a contest this year. The wideout played just 15 snaps on offense, which ranked fifth at his position behind Courtland Sutton (49), Pat Bryant (40), Jaylen Waddle (39) and Troy Franklin (24) for Denver in Week 11. Mims will remain an unappealing…

news.headline: Singletary finished with one carry for five yards and one catch for five yards in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
news.story: The running back played just 10 offensive snaps behind starter Cam Skattebo. Singletary has averaged just 2.9 yards per carry this year on 41 attempts.

news.headline: Taylor caught two passes for 25 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: The Jets controlled this game from start to finish and never trailed, so Geno Smith attempted just 21 passes to 37 run plays for New York. Taylor's 25 yards were his most in a game since Week 7, and he's totaled just 10 catches for 75 yards and no touchdowns over his last four contests. He's a very risky play as a fantasy tight end.

news.headline: With Omar Cooper (ankle) ruled out, coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Taylor could see more pass-catching opportunities Sunday against the Chargers.
news.story: Isaiah Williams (ribs) also has been ruled out for the Jets, so they'll be down their Nos. 3 and 4 receivers, which could lead to more multiple-tight end sets for New York. Taylor is averaging 2.8 catches for 20.9 yards per game this season. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet.

news.headline: Taylor caught all four of his targets for 20 yards during the Jets' 31-12 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.story: Taylor's four catches were tied with Breece Hall and Isaiah Williams for second most on the Jets behind Garrett Wilson, who turned 14 targets into a 7-106-1 line. It was the third time this season that Taylor recorded at least four catches, with his last instance being Week 7 against the Dolphins (five receptions). The second-year tight end has a 22-167-2 line on 29 targets through eight regular-season games…

Corum rushed 17 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Corum was far more productive than backfield mate Kyren Williams, who he outpaced by five carries and 77 rushing yards. It was the fourth straight game with double-digit rush attempts and a touchdown for Corum, with Sunday's score coming from one yard out early in the third quarter. He has at least 73 rushing yards in three of the last four contests, and it remains to be seen if Sunday's division of labor will have…

news.headline: Parkinson caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Parkinson was able to shed an injury designation for Sunday's game after having his practice reps limited during Week 10 prep due to a lingering rib injury. His second catch of the contest went for 10 yards early in the third quarter and set the Rams up on the 1-yard line, with Blake Corum finding the end zone on the next play. Parkinson was on the field for 53 of the Rams' 76 offensive snaps (69.7 percent), and…

news.headline: Fehoko caught one of five targets for a two-yard touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: The wideout led his position group by playing 52 of 56 offensive snaps, and he ran a team-high 34 routes on Josh Johnson's 37 dropbacks. It didn't translate to much production outside of the short touchdown, as Fehoko has consistently shown he can't win enough as an NFL receiver. He's been thrust into heavy snaps due to a litany of injuries in Arizona. Fehoko can mostly be ignored in fantasy until he shows…

news.headline: Fehoko finished Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams with one catch on two targets for 21 yards. He also recorded a tackle.
news.story: Week 10 was the Cardinals' first game with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck as the starting quarterback. The offense struggled to move the ball and logged only 35 snaps as a whole while finishing with 17:37 in time of possession. That meant less opportunities for Fehoko and the rest of the Cardinals' skill-position players, although the sixth-year pro did connect with Beck on a 21-yard pass early in the first…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Darnold has been sidelined for the Seahawks' last two games due to a quad issue and a cracked rib, but he was back on the field Monday for a bonus practice coming out of the bye week. While Macdonald relayed that Darnold "looked great" and took "a ton of reps" during what the coach referred to as more of a walk-through session, the Seahawks want to see how the veteran quarterback responds to a full-speed practice…

news.headline: Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) was suited up for Monday's unofficial practice, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
news.story: The Seahawks are coming off a Week 11 bye, so they're allowed to hold a session outside of the normal bounds under NFL rules. Darnold sat out Weeks 9 and 10 due to a quad injury and cracked ribs that he sustained during a Week 8 loss to the Bears, but head coach Mike Macdonald has said multiple times in the interim that the team is optimistic that its No. 1 QB will return in Week 12. Wednesday's practice report…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle…
news.story: Darnold, who last played in Week 8, still is working his way through a pair of injuries, but barring any setbacks, he's trending toward a Week 12 return. Macdonald reiterated that Darnold will be the team's starter once healthy, even though backup Drew Lock has guided Seattle to a 4-0 record while coming on in relief or starting in place of an injured Darnold in the first two games of the season as well as the most…

news.headline: The Eagles signed Ertz from the practice squad to the active roster Monday.
news.story: Philadelphia is coming off a Week 10 bye, but prior to the midseason respite, there were no reported injuries in the TE group on the active roster. When the position group was depleted earlier this season, the team used elevations on Ertz from Weeks 3-5, but his snap share decreased game by game (38, 21 and 11 percent), while he hauled in three of eight targets for 22 yards in that span. Wednesday's practice report…

news.headline: Branch (hamstring) went through warmups during the media-viewing portion of Monday's unofficial practice session, Daniel Flick of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.
news.story: It's unclear how much work Branch was able to get in Monday, but his presence alone opens the door for a Week 12 return. The Falcons will provide an official update on his status when they release their first injury report of the week Wednesday.

news.headline: Burks was targeted three times for zero catches, had one kick return for 10 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
news.story: Burks was the No. 2 wide receiver for the Colts in the contest. Despite being targeted three times, the wide receiver could not haul in any passes from since-cut quarterback Daniel Jones. Burks played 32 offensive snaps and two special-teams snaps in the contest.

news.headline: Burks failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded one tackle on special teams.
news.story: With Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being shipped off at the Nov. 10 deadline, the Colts turned to Burks, Laquon Treadwell and Anthony Gould to serve as the top wideouts for Week 10. Burks' 34 offensive snaps were a season high and second among the team's wide receivers, but the rookie seventh-rounder failed to record a catch for the fifth time in 10 games, with one of his intended passes from Daniel Jones being…

news.headline: Daniels caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) inactive, Daniels' 46 snaps were two fewer than Konata Mumpfield for the team lead at receiver for the Rams. Mumpfield led the group in targets (four), catches (three) and yards (81), and only Xavier Smith (2-40-1) joined him as wide receivers to catch more than one pass from Matthew Stafford against Arizona while the Rams relied heavily on their tight ends…

news.headline: Williams (toe) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
news.story: Listed as a limited participant on the Rams' initial Week 12 injury report posted Sunday, Williams quelled any concern about his status for Wednesday's game against the Packers by taking full reps a day later. Though his sore toe isn't expected to affect his workload, Williams nonetheless may find himself in a timeshare with Blake Corum, who has been the more productive option on the ground this season. Williams…

news.headline: Williams (toe) was a limited practice participant Sunday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
news.story: Head coach Sean McVay relayed to Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com on Saturday that Williams is dealing with a sore toe, so his practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep aren't a surprise. Williams will have two more chances to put himself in a position to avoid a designation for Wednesday's game against the Packers.

news.headline: Head coach Sean McVay said Saturday that Williams is tending to a sore toe but is expected to play Wednesday against the Packers, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports.
news.story: The Rams are in the midst of their Week 11 bye, but with a Wednesday game on tap in Week 12, the team is getting back on the practice field this weekend. He'll have three more days to work through the new health concern, but considering McVay's comments, Williams should be fine to continue to work in tandem with fellow RB Blake Corum.

news.headline: TeSlaa failed to catch any of his three targets during Sunday's 31-21 win over the Buccaneers.
news.story: TeSlaa went without a reception for the second time in four weeks, and he has now gone six straight games without exceeding 20 receiving yards. The wide receiver played 23 snaps on offense, ranking third at his position behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (46) and Jameson Williams (45). TeSlaa will continue to be an unreliable fantasy option ahead of the team's Week 12 matchup with the Bears on Thursday.

news.headline: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.
news.story: It was a quiet day for TeSlaa, with the Lions' offense being powered by usual suspects Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs, with the latter duo combining for four touchdowns (three receiving, one rushing). TeSlaa was the other Lions player to find the end zone, which took place early in the second quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from Jared Goff. It was the first touchdown catch of the season for TeSlaa, who…

news.headline: The Eagles listed Barkley (neck/illness) as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Though Tuesday's injury report was merely an estimate, Barkley would have been able to take every rep had the Eagles held a traditional practice session. Barkley emerged from this past Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers with a neck injury and an illness, but neither health concern looks like it will prevent him from playing Thursday in Dallas.

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.
news.story: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team…

news.headline: Higbee caught three of four targets for 17 yards and a touchdown during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Higbee's third and final catch of Sunday's game came late in the second quarter, with the veteran tight end connecting with Matthew Stafford for a five-yard touchdown to give the Rams a 10-6 lead. It was the second touchdown of the season for Higbee, with his first taking place in Week 3 against the Broncos. He's been held to three catches or fewer in each of his last four games, although he's been on the field for…

news.headline: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: The Steelers haven't yet brought Pittman back from injured reserve, but he stands a good chance at being activated for Friday's game against the Broncos. Pittman was listed as a full participant Tuesday on a third consecutive practice report as he works to regain conditioning after missing the Steelers' last six games.

news.headline: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he's "very confident" Pittman (foot) will be on the field this week when the Steelers face the Broncos on Friday, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Pittman was designated for return from IR this past Wednesday, but despite being listed as a full participant in practice Thursday and Friday, the Steelers elected to not activate the WR (who had been listed as questionable) for Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Added context regarding Pittman's status will arrive via Pittsburgh's next practice report, but barring any setbacks, it appears as though he's…

news.headline: Pittman (foot) is not expected to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN reports.
news.story: Pittman was able to practice fully both Thursday and Friday, but he is not ready to rejoin the mix just yet -- which Pittsburgh confirmed by omitting Pittman from the list of roster moves it made Saturday. Barring an unannounced setback, Pittman figures to continue practicing, and his next chance to take the field will arrive Black Friday, when the Steelers square off against the Broncos.

news.story: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. news.headline: Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that DeVito will start in Week 12 against the Chargers on Nov. 29, Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter of ESPN.com report.
news.story: Drake Maye was diagnosed with a fractured right fibula, which he sustained in the first quarter of the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Week 10 in Munich. DeVito filled in for the rest of that contest and completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards, one touchdown and one interception while turning four carries into 19 yards. DeVito looks like he'll be New England's starter coming out of the bye, with rookie…

news.headline: Mike Reiss of ESPN.com notes via ESPN's Adam Schefter that there are fears DeVito's teammate, Drake Maye, may have sustained a fractured ankle during Week 10 action.
news.story: Regarding Maye's status going forward, head coach Mike Vrabel indicated that he'll wait for further information before estimating how long his starting QB might be out, but he also acknowledged he "wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the (Week 11) bye," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports. As a result, DeVito is in a position to start Sunday, Nov. 29 against the Chargers and possibly beyond. That…

news.headline: Latu recorded a 30-yard reception on four targets in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.story: With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) inactive, Latu moved a rung up on the ladder at tight end and ended up seeing his most extensive playing time on offense of the season, logging 28 of 78 snaps (36 percent). He parlayed the elevated snaps into a season-high target count, but Latu's lone reception actually came on special teams, when Tommy Doman faked a punt and connected with the 24-year-old deep down the field for a…

news.headline: Stowers didn't log any offensive snaps in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Dallas Goedert (47 snaps), Johnny Mundt (eight) and Zach Ertz (six) handled tight-end duties for Philly, while Stowers played 20 snaps on special teams. The rookie tight end is miles from fantasy relevance this season.

news.headline: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
news.story: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders…

Mayfield completed 20 of 33 passes for 187 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.
news.story: Mayfield fought through foot and thumb injuries to take the field in a critical game for the 3-6 Buccaneers, but he wasn't able to keep pace with Jared Goff and Jahmyr Gibbs. Mayfield did throw multiple touchdown passes for the first time this season, hitting rookie Ted Hurst for scoring strikes of 23 and four yards. news.headline: Mayfield (foot/thumb) is listed as active Sunday at Detroit, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
news.story: With the Buccaneers on bye in Week 10, Mayfield was front and center following a report from Mike Garafolo of NFL Network last Sunday that the quarterback's status for Week 11 was up in the air due to a foot injury. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network then reported Tuesday that Mayfield "seems to be trending" toward missing Sunday's game. news.headline: Johnson caught two of three targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: After being benched in the Bucs' pre-Week 9 bye loss to the Bears, Ted Hurst was back in the good graces of the coaching staff and played ahead of Johnson as the WR3 behind Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin. That left Johnson as the fourth receiver, playing just 20 of 69 offensive snaps. He has 13 catches for 271 yards and one touchdown on 23 targets across 10 games this season.

news.headline: Otton caught one pass for eight yards on three targets in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: The tight end earned just a 9.1 percent target share and continues to be nearly invisible in the box score despite being an every-down player who runs virtually every pass route for the Bucs. Otton has just one touchdown since Week 11 of the 2024 season and has just one career 100-yard receiving game across 73 regular-season contests. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet who clearly busts far more than he hits.

news.headline: Thomas brought in two of three targets for 56 yards and added a 30-yard carry during the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.story: Thomas was cleared to play Sunday after working through an ankle issue that prevented him from practicing Friday. The ankle didn't appear to bother him, as he turned his first touch of the game into a 30-yard rush midway through the second quarter before connecting with Caleb Williams for 40 and 16 yards in the third and fourth quarters, respectively. It was the rookie third-round wideout's best performance of the…

news.headline: Thomas (ankle) is active for Sunday's matchup against New Orleans.
news.story: Thomas popped up on the practice report as a nonparticipant Friday due to an ankle issue and was initially deemed questionable for Sunday. However, the rookie will ultimately be able to play through the issue. Thomas typically has a minimal role on offense, as he's caught more than one pass in only one of his nine appearances so far. However, he's worked as Chicago's primary kickoff returner and should again…

news.headline: Thomas (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Saints.
news.story: Thomas appears to have picked up an injury in the Bears' lead-up to Week 11, as he did not participate in Friday's practice. The rookie third-rounder acts as the team's top kick-return option. Should he not play, Josh Blackwell may take over duties on special teams.

Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. news.headline: Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.story: Stroud looked like he was on his way to another highly productive day early while helping stake the Texans to a 17-0 lead in the first half, but the fourth-year signal-caller and his offense largely stagnated in the second half. Stroud spread the ball around while connecting with eight different targets overall, and his trio of scoring strikes went to Nico Collins (12 yards), Xavier Hutchinson (11 yards) and Dalton…

news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in…

news.headline: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
news.story: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the…

news.headline: Koziol went without a target while playing four of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: The rookie fifth-round pick saw his streak of three straight games with a reception come to an end and also had his snap count decline for the fourth week in a row. Koziol ranked fourth in playing time among Jacksonville tight ends, marking the first time since Week 3 that he had played behind Quintin Morris (11 snaps Sunday).

news.headline: Smith caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With the Rams down both Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) for the first time this season, Smith operated as the fourth receiver against Arizona, playing nine of 76 offensive snaps. His 22-yard touchdown in the second quarter was the first of Smith's career. Based on his small amount of playing time and routes run, Smith's 12-point PPR day isn't worth chasing in fantasy.

news.headline: Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.
news.story: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Both of Young's scores came in the first half, as he connected with Mitchell Evans on a 23-yard TD and Tetairoa McMillan on a seven-yard strike. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Young was listed with a sore foot on Wednesday's injury report but was a full participant in the Panthers' first Week 11 practice.
news.story: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
Johnson caught his only target for 15 yards during Sunday's 23-18 win versus the Jaguars.
news.story: Johnson was third in offensive snaps (14) among Giants tight ends Sunday behind starter Isaiah Likely (49) and veteran Chris Manhertz (19). With that said, Johnson did manage to record at least one catch for the fourth time in his last five games. As long as Likely remains available, though, Johnson will remain in a rotational role.

news.headline: Johnston caught one of two targets for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets. He added one yard on one rushing attempt.
news.story: Johnston was targeted on just 9.5 percent of Justin Herbert's 21 pass attempts against New York. The wideout has now caught exactly one pass in three straight games and in five of his last six contests. Johnston is a lightly targeted deep threat who will likely continue to see fewer looks if Ladd McConkey is able to maintain his health for an extended period.

news.headline: Johnston brought in his sole target for six yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
news.story: The speedster was poised to see some added involvement with Ladd McConkey (back) sidelined, but that never materialized on a night when 86 of Justin Herbert's 129 passing yards went to Tre' Harris. Johnston's yardage total was a season-low figure, and he's now been limited to one reception in four of the last five games. Johnston's often been able to offset the modest catch totals with big plays, but that clearly…

news.headline: Washington caught all three targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
news.story: The big tight end earned just a 6.8 percent target share on a day when Aaron Rodgers fired off 44 pass attempts in prolonged comeback mode. Washington has been held to 25 yards or fewer in eight of 10 games this season. He doesn't see enough volume to warrant weekly fantasy consideration as a touchdown-or-bust bet.

news.headline: Washington caught one pass for five yards on two targets in Sunday night's loss to the Bengals.
news.story: Aaron Rodgers threw for 143 yards in the game, and most of that came in garbage time in the second half with the score already out of hand. Washington has fewer than 30 receiving yards in seven of nine games played this season and is the epitome of a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at tight end.

news.headline: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.
news.story: The Saints expect to have a better feel for Johnson's status Wednesday, when the team holds its first practice of Week 12. Before exiting Sunday in the third quarter, Johnson was targeted just once and failed to record a reception for the second time in 10 appearances on the season. If the hamstring injury prevents Johnson from playing next weekend in Cincinnati, Noah Fant and Oscar Delp would be in line for added…

news.headline: Johnson injured his hamstring during Sunday's game in Chicago, Jeff Nowak of WWL Radio reports.
news.story: Johnson visited the sideline tent in the third quarter before the Saints deemed him questionable to return. He didn't catch his only target before his departure.

news.headline: Johnson caught two passes for 28 yards on three targets in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.story: With Jordyn Tyson playing his second game since debuting last week, the rookie wideout was targeted 13 times on Tyler Shough's 35 pass attempts. It didn't leave much for the rest of New Orleans' pass catchers, as Travis Etienne was actually second on the team with five targets. Over his last five games, Johnson has nine catches for 85 yards and a score. He's become a low-end TE2 for fantasy.

news.headline: Brown went without a target while playing eight of the Colts' 50 offensive snaps in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: For the second week in a row, Brown ended up seeing more snaps on special teams (11) than offense. Through four games with Indianapolis, Brown has drawn just one target, which he turned into a seven-yard reception during a Week 6 loss to the Titans.

news.headline: The Chiefs listed Walker (groin) as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.
news.story: After he had been listed as a non-participant on five straight injury reports and missed two games along the way, Walker was able to take a step forward Tuesday as he works his way back from a sore groin. Per Nate Taylor of ESPN.com, head coach Andy Reid said prior to the session that Walker was "feeling pretty good," while noting that Tuesday's practice would be important in deciding whether the running back suits…

news.headline: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said that Walker (groin) will practice Tuesday, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports. "I'm not anticipating a ton of work," Reid said. "Let's see how does. He's feeling pretty good."
news.story: Walker has been sidelined for the Chiefs' last two games due to a sore groin and was listed as a non-participant in Monday's practice. Though the running back appears poised to take a step forward in terms of activity Tuesday, Reid's comments suggest that Walker will likely be a limited participant. The Chiefs will wait and see how Walker responds to practice Tuesday before having a better feel for his status for…

news.headline: Walker (groin) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's practice estimate.
news.story: Since the Chiefs are coming off a 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday, the team held a walkthrough Monday in preparation for Thursday's game against the Bills. Nate Taylor of ESPN.com previously reported that the Chiefs are "optimistic" that Walker may be available for the team's Thanksgiving night contest, but with one 'DNP' now on the books, the running back has two more opportunities to log any listed level of…

news.headline: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
news.story: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders…

Duvernay logged 81 kickoff-return yards in the Cardinals' 34-7 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.
news.story: Duvernay played two offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver took a step back after drawing three targets in Week 10, as both Simi Fehoko and Harrison Wallace were clearly ahead of him Sunday.

news.headline: Duvernay caught two of three targets for 35 yards during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
news.story: Duvernay was on the field for only 10 of the Cardinals' 35 offensive snaps (28.6 percent), but the veteran wide receiver connected with rookie third-round quarterback Carson Beck on passes of four and 31 yards on back-to-back plays late in the first quarter. Duvernay finished the contest second in catches, targets and receiving yards behind Trey McBride, and he's caught two passes in each of his last three outings.…

news.headline: Hibner recorded two catches for 12 yards on two targets in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.story: Hibner logged 35 of 65 snaps on offense, with his 54 percent share ranking second to only Mark Andrews (62 percent) among Ravens tight ends. The rookie fourth-round pick out of SMU's playing time has held steady between 30 and 60 percent of snaps over his 10 appearances, with Hibner drawing no more than two targets in any of those contests.

news.headline: Treadwell failed to catch his lone target in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: Treadwell played a position-high 40 of 50 offensive snaps but continues to run wind sprints in an offense that doesn't throw the ball down the field. Through 11 games this season, Treadwell has just 19 catches for 239 yards and one touchdown on 33 targets.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Replacing Drake Maye? Trust in Tyson?
Treadwell caught three passes on as many targets for 24 yards and a touchdown during Indianapolis' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.story: Week 10 was the Colts' first game without Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, who were traded to the Chiefs and 49ers, respectively, on Tuesday. Treadwell led all Colts wide receivers with three catches and 52 offensive snaps, and he connected with Daniel Jones for a seven-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to give Indianapolis a 14-7 halftime lead. It was the first time Treadwell found the end zone this…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Darnold has been sidelined for the Seahawks' last two games due to a quad issue and a cracked rib, but he was back on the field Monday for a bonus practice coming out of the bye week. While Macdonald relayed that Darnold "looked great" and took "a ton of reps" during what the coach referred to as more of a walk-through session, the Seahawks want to see how the veteran quarterback responds to a full-speed practice…

news.headline: Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) was suited up for Monday's unofficial practice, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
news.story: The Seahawks are coming off a Week 11 bye, so they're allowed to hold a session outside of the normal bounds under NFL rules. Darnold sat out Weeks 9 and 10 due to a quad injury and cracked ribs that he sustained during a Week 8 loss to the Bears, but head coach Mike Macdonald has said multiple times in the interim that the team is optimistic that its No. 1 QB will return in Week 12. Wednesday's practice report…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle…
news.story: Darnold, who last played in Week 8, still is working his way through a pair of injuries, but barring any setbacks, he's trending toward a Week 12 return. Macdonald reiterated that Darnold will be the team's starter once healthy, even though backup Drew Lock has guided Seattle to a 4-0 record while coming on in relief or starting in place of an injured Darnold in the first two games of the season as well as the most…

news.headline: Mitchell recorded two receptions for 40 yards on two targets in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.story: The fifth-year tight end was one of eight pass catchers that quarterback Dak Prescott connected with on the afternoon, with the pair of receptions marking Mitchell's first two grabs of the season. Mitchell took the field for 15 of the Cowboys' 65 snaps on offense, but he could wind up seeing most of his playing time on special teams once top tight end Jake Ferguson is cleared to return from the knee injury that has…

news.headline: Bellinger made one catch for five yards in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
news.story: Bellinger played 26 offensive snaps and five special-teams snaps in the contest. The tight end capitalized on his sole target but was primarily utilized as a blocker in the blowout loss.

news.headline: Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
news.story: The blocking specialist played 28 of 57 offensive snaps and was asked to block on 12 of those plays. His two-yard touchdown in the second quarter was Bellinger's first of the season. For the year, Bellinger has 11 grabs for 76 yards and the score on 18 targets across nine contests.
