news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Gesicki brought in five of six targets for 77 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
news.story: The veteran tight end finished with a team-high yardage total while coming just a yard short of equaling his best tally of the season as well. Gesicki's biggest catch came late in the fourth quarter on the Bengals' final drive, when he hauled in a 32-yard pass from Joe Burrow over the middle to get the Bengals down to the Commanders' 33-yard line. Gesicki's production continues to have some game-to-game volatility,…

news.headline: What to know to set your lineup: Nix, Ward viable options if your QB is on bye
Higbee caught three of four targets for 17 yards and a touchdown during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Higbee's third and final catch of Sunday's game came late in the second quarter, with the veteran tight end connecting with Matthew Stafford for a five-yard touchdown to give the Rams a 10-6 lead. It was the second touchdown of the season for Higbee, with his first taking place in Week 3 against the Broncos. He's been held to three catches or fewer in each of his last four games, although he's been on the field for…

news.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Coleman surges among RBs, Taylor sinks
Fantasy football free agent pickups: Grab your Rams and Packers quickly

The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The…
news.story: Nacua is expected to miss "a couple of months" after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, per Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com. With Nacua and Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) sidelined for Week 10 against the Cardinals, Mumpfield operated as the Rams' WR1 for that contest and finished with three catches (on four targets) for 81 yards in a 34-6 win for Los Angeles. The Rams are "hopeful" that Adams will return soon,…

news.headline: Atwell caught one of two targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: Despite both Puka Nacua (toe/knee) and Davante Adams (hamstring) being sidelined, Atwell still played just 16 of 76 offensive snaps versus Arizona and ran 15 routes on Matthew Stafford's 28 dropbacks. Atwell played behind both Konata Mumpfield and CJ Daniels at receiver for Los Angeles.

news.headline: Daniels caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) inactive, Daniels' 46 snaps were two fewer than Konata Mumpfield for the team lead at receiver for the Rams. Mumpfield led the group in targets (four), catches (three) and yards (81), and only Xavier Smith (2-40-1) joined him as wide receivers to catch more than one pass from Matthew Stafford against Arizona while the Rams relied heavily on their tight ends…

news.headline: Raymond caught one of four passes for 14 yards during Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
news.story: Raymond's four targets were tied with Rome Odunze for most on the Bears on Sunday, although the former could muster only a 14-yard grab early in the second quarter. Raymond has commanded four targets or more in six of 10 regular-season games and is up to a 33-304-1 line on 45 targets while operating as Chicago's WR3 behind Odunze and Luther Burden. The Bears will hit the road to face the Lions on Thanksgiving Day.

news.headline: Roush brought in his lone target for 19 yards during Chicago's 21-13 win over New Orleans on Sunday.
news.story: The rookie third-rounder connected with Caleb Williams for a 19-yard catch midway through the first quarter, although Roush didn't see another target the rest of the way. With Cole Kmet (knee, IR) out for the rest of the year, Roush will continue to serve as the Bears' TE2 behind Colston Loveland. The Bears are on the road for Thanksgiving Day against the Lions, whose defense ranks dead last in the NFL in fantasy…

news.headline: Wright caught both of two targets for 42 yards during Sunday's 31-21 win versus the Buccaneers.
news.story: One of Wright's two grabs in Week 11 was a 27-yard strike up the seam, easily his longest reception of the season thus far. He was on the field for 43 of the Lions' 58 offensive snaps Sunday, but he spent a substantial majority of those on blocking assignments for tailback Jahmyr Gibbs and company. His role in a Thanksgiving tilt versus the Bears may depend somewhat on the health of running mate Sam LaPorta, who…

news.headline: Wright caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: Wright tied season highs in both receiving yards and catches during Sunday's win, and his 39 snaps on offense were second-most among Lions tight ends behind Sam LaPorta (56). Wright has accumulated seven catches on eight target for 42 yards across nine regular-season games, and he's mostly served as a blocking tight end on the Lions' offense.

news.headline: Conklin went without a target while playing 22 of the Lions' 71 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
news.story: A healthy inactive for two of the Lions' first four games of the season, Conklin has now suited up for five consecutive contests. However, the veteran tight end has been handling a limited role, logging less than one-third of the offensive snaps in any of his seven appearances on the season while compiling a 2-11-0 receiving line on three targets.

news.headline: Carlson played 15 of his 19 snaps on special teams in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
news.story: Though he's been active for each of the Bears' last three games in the wake of Cole Kmet's season-ending knee injury, Carlson remains well behind Colston Loveland and Sam Roush in the pecking order at tight end. Carlson has yet to draw a target and has now played more snaps on special teams than offense in the past two contests.

news.headline: Spann-Ford caught both of his targets for five yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.story: With Jake Ferguson (knee) still sidelined, Spann-Ford played 44 of 65 offensive snaps against Tennessee and ran 17 routes on Dak Prescott's 36 dropbacks. The Cowboys don't throw to their tight ends often and funnel most targets through CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, but Spann-Ford did catch a two-yard touchdown late in the fourth quarter. He has 18 catches for 161 yards and the one score on 26 targets across 11…

news.headline: Spann-Ford caught one of three targets for 26 yards during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
news.story: Spann-Ford operated as the Cowboys' No. 1 tight end in Week 10 due to the absence of Jake Ferguson (knee). However, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy were the top targets for Dak Prescott. Ferguson is expected to be sidelined for multiple weeks while recovering from his injury, so Spann-Ford should once again top the depth chart in Week 11 against a Titans team that has given up 40-plus points in each…

news.headline: Schoonmaker caught his lone target for six yards in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.story: With Jake Ferguson (knee) remaining out for Dallas, Schoonmaker played 25 of 65 offensive snaps behind Brevyn Spann-Ford. Schoonmaker ran 12 routes, five fewer than Spann-Ford, and the duo combined to see three targets on a day Dak Prescott attempted 33 passes. Schoonmaker has five catches for 48 yards on six targets across nine games this season and has no fantasy appeal.

news.headline: Schoonmaker (illness) is active for Sunday's Week 11 matchup against Tennessee.
news.story: Schoonmaker was unable to practice Thursday or Friday because he was under the weather, but the tight end appears to be feeling well enough to suit up Sunday. Meanwhile, Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) will miss his second straight game, opening the door for Schoonmaker to potentially log a larger workload than usual on offense. With Ferguson out last Sunday versus San Francisco, Schoonmaker posted a season-high 35…

news.headline: Schoonmaker (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: Schoonmaker was held out of practice Thursday and Friday due to an illness, and he's drawn the questionable tag heading into the weekend. Jake Ferguson (knee) has already been ruled out, and with Schoonmaker under the weather, that leaves Brevyn Spann-Ford and James Mitchell as the Cowboys' two healthy tight ends on the 53-man roster ahead of Sunday's contest. Michael Trigg could be elevated from the practice squad…

news.headline: Ferguson (knee/ankle) remained a non-participant in practice Tuesday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: Ferguson hasn't practiced in any fashion since exiting the Cowboys' Week 9 win over the Colts. Unless he's able to mix into drills Wednesday, Ferguson will likely be sidelined for a third straight game Thursday, when the Cowboys host the Eagles in a Thanksgiving Day contest.

news.headline: Ferguson (knee/ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's practice estimate, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: Per Todd Archer of ESPN.com, Ferguson was present for the Cowboys' walkthrough Monday, but he wouldn't have been able to take any reps had the team held a traditional practice session. Ferguson, who has missed two straight contests, will have two more chances to potentially upgrade his practice activity this week before the Cowboys make a call on his status for Thursday's game against the Eagles.

news.headline: Ferguson (knee) was present for Monday's walkthrough, Todd Archer of ESPN reports.
news.story: Since injuring his knee in a Week 9 win at Indianapolis, Ferguson has been listed as a non-participant on practice reports the last two weeks and missed the past two games as a result. It remains to be seen if he'll officially mix into drills Monday, but he at least is making progress in his recovery effort as the Cowboys begin prep for Thursday's contest against the Eagles.

news.headline: Knox caught two of three targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
news.story: Knox was the top available TE for the Bills in the absence of Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle). The added opportunities helped Knox post his second-highest total of the season in receiving yards, but Knox remains off the radar in most fantasy formats heading into Thursday's game against the Chiefs. He hasn't scored since Week 2 while recording a meager 117 yards on 16 catches through 10 games.

news.headline: Knox will likely be the Bills' top tight end against the Dolphins on Sunday, given that Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for that contest, Maddy Glab of the Bills' official site reports.
news.story: Kincaid was held out of practice all week while tending to thumb and ankle injuries, and he's trending toward being inactive for Sunday's AFC East tilt. If Kincaid is indeed ruled out, then Knox will operate as the Bills' top tight end, with Jackson Hawes (shoulder) and Keleki Latu also in line for larger roles on offense. Knox has 14 catches (on 20 targets) for 86 yards and a touchdown through nine regular-season…

news.headline: Knox caught one of his three targets for seven yards in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat. Knox played 41 offensive snaps in Sunday's game and was on the field for 72 percent of the Bills' offensive plays.

news.headline: Gray (ribs) was a full participant at the Chiefs' practice Tuesday.
news.story: Gray was considered to be a nonparticipant at the team's walkthrough practice Monday due to an injury to his ribs, but he now appears to be good to go for Week 12. The 27-year-old will operate in his primary reserve role behind Travis Kelce at tight end Thursday versus the Bills.

news.headline: Gray (ribs) was deemed a non-participant in Monday's walkthrough.
news.story: Kansas City didn't actually practice Monday, but Gray's DNP tag is nonetheless concerning with the club set to take the field Thursday versus Buffalo. Gray was injured late in Sunday's win over Arizona and didn't re-enter the contest. If the veteran tight end isn't able to suit up against the Bills, Jake Briningstool could see more work on offense as Travis Kelce's backup.

news.headline: Gray (ribs) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against Arizona.
news.story: Gray's injury status was announced late in the game after Kansas City had already built an insurmountable lead, so it would be a surprise if the tight end returns to the contest. The bigger picture is the Chiefs' Thanksgiving matchup against Buffalo -- if Gray is dealing with a more-than-minor issue, his availability for that game could be in peril. Gray finished Sunday's matchup with three catches for 21 yards on…

news.headline: Briningstool caught one of two targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 35-13 win against the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Briningstool connected with Patrick Mahomes for a 20-yard reception midway through the first quarter but didn't record another reception. The 23-year-old tight end has exactly one catch in each of his past three games. That's not enough production to warrant fantasy consideration, but Briningstool is at least showing growth as a pass catcher, as he had just one catch on two targets over his first six contests of…

news.headline: Hawes (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Hawes was in danger of missing this contest due to a shoulder issue, though he will avoid his first absence of the 2026 campaign Sunday versus Miami. With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) sidelined in Week 11, Hawes will have an opportunity to get more involved than usual behind Dawson Knox.

news.headline: Hawes (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Hawes' practice reps during Week 11 prep were limited by a shoulder injury, which he may have picked up during the Bills' Week 10 win over the Jets. Dalton Kincaid (thumb) is listed as doubtful, so that leaves Dawson Knox and Keleki Latu as the two healthy tight ends on the Bills' 53-man roster heading into the weekend. If Hawes is cleared to play, then he would operate as the TE2 behind Knox in the event that…

news.headline: Hawes (shoulder) was a late addition to Wednesday's injury report, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News.
news.story: It is unclear whether Hawes suffered his shoulder injury, however, his eligibility for Week 11 against the Dolphins will likely be decided during the Thursday and Friday prep sessions. The 25-year-old will need to upgrade to a full participant by Friday's practice to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's contest.

news.headline: Jennings caught three of six targets for 20 yards during Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: Jennings made his return to action after missing two games with a calf injury. The 29-year-old reeled in a season-high three passes, while his six targets were also the most he's had in a game this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 40 receiving yards in contest, and Jennings hasn't scored a touchdown this season. His next chance to accomplish both feats will come in Week 12 versus the Falcons.

news.headline: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
news.story: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this…

news.headline: Yurosek failed to draw a target while playing 29 of the Vikings' 67 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.
news.story: Since being reinstated from injured reserve in Week 5, Yurosek has cleared 40 percent snap shares in five of the Vikings' ensuing six games. However, he remains a fringe part of the passing attack, having thus far mustered a 3-41-0 receiving line on four targets. He ran routes on just nine of his 29 snaps in Week 11, with Yurosek mainly serving as a blocker during his time on the field.

news.headline: Schultz brought in his only target for 11 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Schultz had a minimal role on a night when C.J. Stroud threw for a modest 194 yards and recorded completions to nine different targets. The veteran tight end now has consecutive one-catch, 11-yard tallies after recording multiple receptions in each of his first eight games of the season, and Schultz's production will remain hard to trust heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

news.headline: Schultz caught one pass for an 11-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.story: While Schultz got into the end zone for the first time this campaign, his catches and targets were new single-game lows for 2026. Schultz has yet to produce more than 45 yards in a game when Nico Collins is healthy this season. The veteran tight end is a low-floor, TD-or-bust fantasy bet.

news.headline: Cuevas caught one of three targets for eight yards during Sunday's 35-33 loss at Carolina.
news.story: Cuevas continues to draw targets at an impressive clip, tallying three for his second straight game despite only being on the field for 14 of the Ravens' 61 offensive snaps in Week 11. Barring an injury to starter Mark Andrews or rookie fourth-rounder Matt Hibner, though, his role isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats. Baltimore will take on the Texans in Week 12.

news.headline: Cuevas caught all three of his targets for 37 yards during Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
news.story: Cuevas had an immediate connection with new starting quarterback Jacoby Brissett, reeling in at least three passes for the second time this season and the first time since Week 6. The tight end ranked fourth at his position with 11 offensive snaps, sitting behind Mark Andrews (40), Matthew Hibner (22) and Nick Vannett (14). Cuevas has now caught 13 of 16 targets for 171 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests so far…

news.headline: Jordan (foot/illness) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.
news.story: Jordan missed all three Week 11 practice sessions due to an injury and an illness. The tight end will miss a second straight game, this time with two separate issues as opposed to the finger injury that plagued him ahead of Week 10. Marlin Klein or Cade Stover is set to be the No. 3 tight end behind Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau for Thursday night's contest.

news.headline: Jordan (foot/illness) did not participate at practice Tuesday.
news.story: Jordan missed Sunday's game at Cleveland because of a finger injury, but it's now a foot issue and an illness that's keeping him off the practice field. If he doesn't practice in some capacity Wednesday, he'll probably end up listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Colts.

news.headline: Fant caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
news.story: Fant played 49 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest. The starting tight end was on the field for 69 percent of the team's offensive plays but remains off the same page with quarterback Tyler Shough. The tight end's five targets are the most attention he has seen since Week 1 against the Lions.

news.headline: Fant failed to haul in his lone target during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
news.story: Fant didn't connect with Tyler Shough on a short pass late in the first quarter, and that ended up being the only target for the veteran tight end. Fant has a 12-96-3 line on 19 targets through eight regular-season games, although he's logged one reception or zero in four of his last five outings. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal as the Saints' TE2 behind Juwan Johnson heading into Week 11 against the Bears on…

news.headline: Delp hauled in his lone target for a six-yard reception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
news.story: The rookie third-round pick out of Georgia has handled a muted role at tight end behind Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant this season, compiling five receptions for 26 yards on five targets through nine appearances. Delp was limited to just 21 of the Saints' 72 offensive snaps in Week 11, but he could see his playing time pick up if the hamstring injury that knocked Johnson out of Sunday's loss early prevents him from…

news.headline: Gould secured two of three targets for 48 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
news.story: Gould was the rather unlikely leader in receiving yards for the Colts on the night, with a team-high 31-yard catch playing a big role in getting him there. The 2024 fifth-round pick has seen an expanded role in the wake of the trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, and for as long as Alec Pierce (IR, heel) is sidelined, Gould could function as one of Indianapolis' top downfield threats for either Daniel Jones,…

news.headline: Gould (toe) is active for Thursday night's game against the Texans.
news.story: Gould was listed as questionable but is good to go for the divisional affair. He played 32 of 59 offensive snaps last Sunday against Miami, the Colts' first game since trading both Josh Downs and Keenan Allen. Gould manned the slot role vacated by Downs and secured two of four targets for 28 yards. He's a non-flashy but viable click in PPR-based fantasy formats.

news.headline: Gould (toe) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Texans, Abby Halpin of the Colts' official site reports.
news.story: Gould was deemed limited on Monday and Tuesday's practice reports, but he upgraded to a full listing on Wednesday's practice estimate. That suggests that the WR has a solid chance of being available Thursday, but those in leagues deep enough to consider Gould in PPR formats will need to check his availability ahead of the Colts' 8:15 pm ET kickoff. Gould was listed as a starter for this past Sunday's win over the…

news.headline: Giddens will likely move up to the No. 2 RB role for the Colts in the short term, as Seth McGowan is expected to miss time due to a hamstring injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that McGowan "will miss some time" but didn't specify how long the absence may be. For however long McGowan is sidelined, Giddens figures to serve as Jonathan Taylor's backup at running back. Giddens has shown some flashes this season in limited playing time, amassing 48 yards on seven carries (6.9 YPC) and catching his only target for 11 yards over three games.

news.headline: Giddens rushed one time for five yards and caught his lone target for 11 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.story: With Seth McGowan (hamstring) exiting early with an injury, Giddens spelled Jonathan Taylor and played seven offensive snaps. Through three games this season, Giddens has rushed seven times for 48 yards and registered one catch for 11 yards. If McGowan's injury costs him time, Giddens figures to handle RB2 duties in his absence.

news.headline: Giddens played two offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.story: Giddens barely saw the field during Sunday's win, and his two offensive snaps were well behind fellow running backs Jonathan Taylor (40) and Seth McGowan (17). Giddens -- a fifth-round pick of the Colts in the 2025 NFL Draft -- has seen little playing time since making his 2026 regular-season debut in Week 8 against the Jaguars. His role will likely stay minimal for Week 11 against the Texans on Thursday.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Grab your Rams and Packers quickly
Head coach Shane Steichen announced Friday that Richardson will be the Colts' starting quarterback moving forward after the team waived Daniel Jones.
news.story: Richardson made a cameo in Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston, taking over for Jones for Indianapolis' final possession, but the former logged just a two-yard carry and two incompletions before the Texans ate up the final 6:50 of the contest. A 2023 first-round pick, Richardson himself hasn't started since Week 16 of the 2024 campaign, making just four brief appearances the past two seasons combined, but he'll have a…

Why fantasy managers should still trust Trevor Lawrence
Week 11 winners and losers: Cowboys put up points while Josh Allen does not
Morris went without a target while logging 11 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: For the first time since Week 3, Morris earned more playing time on offense than rookie Tanner Koziol (four snaps), who had previously been serving as the Jaguars' No. 3 tight end. Koziol offers more of a pass-catching threat at the position, but Morris is the superior blocker and also has a more integral role on special teams.

news.headline: Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Strange was able to notch at least three catches for the first time since Week 6, but he still finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the second straight week and third time overall this year. The tight end has now reeled in 35 of 43 targets for 381 yards and two touchdowns over 10 contests during the 2026 season.

news.headline: Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
news.story: The Jaguars keep blowing out their opponents, and Strange contributed a three-yard touchdown Sunday but was otherwise not heard from much, as Parker Washington dog-walked the Titans' secondary for 7-152-1 receiving on nine targets. Strange's touchdown grab was his first since Week 1. He remans a locked-in TE1 for fantasy, as he is playing virtually every snap in an elite offense.

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Two Commanders to pick up coming off MNF win
Dike caught six of seven targets for 69 yards during Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Dike was able to reel in multiple passes for the third straight game, and his six snags set a new season high for the second-year pro. The 24-year-old paced the team in targets Sunday, narrowly edging out fellow wide receivers Calvin Ridley (six) and Carnell Tate (five). Dike will have a chance to continue carving out a more substantial role for himself on offense moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle)…

news.headline: Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.
news.story: With Carnell Tate (shoulder) out again, Dike played 54 of 57 offensive snaps against Jacksonville, but his three targets were a distant fifth on the team and represented just an 8.1 percent target share. Outside of his 5-71-1 receiving outburst in Week 8 against Cincinnati, Dike has amassed eight catches for 69 scoreless yards. He's not a reliable fantasy option, though a Week 11 date with Dallas' secondary awaits…

news.headline: Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: Sadiq finished tied for second on the team in targets with wide receiver Adonai Mitchell and running back Breece Hall behind wideout Garrett Wilson (five). The tight end was able to reel in multiple passes for just the second time since catching seven of eight targets for 105 yards and a score in Week 3 against the Lions. Sadiq has now caught 25 of 36 targets for 268 yards and a score while adding a three-yard…

news.headline: With Omar Cooper (ankle) ruled out, coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Sadiq could see more pass-catching opportunities Sunday against the Chargers.
news.story: In addition to Cooper, Isaiah Williams (ribs) also will be sidelined against Los Angeles. Sadiq could essentially handle WR3 duties behind Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell, though it's not the easiest matchup against the Los Angeles defense. Sadiq has a chance to see elevated snaps, which could translate to more targets in the passing game, but he's still difficult to get behind as a fantasy starter.

news.headline: Sadiq was limited to a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.story: On a day in which quarterbacks Geno Smith (ankle) and Cade Klubnik dropped back 45 times, Sadiq wasn't able to see much involvement in the passing game. Though the rookie first-round pick put his pass-catching chops on display with a 7-105-1 receiving line in Week 3 against Detroit, he's since delivered a collective 10-95-0 line on 19 targets over the Jets' ensuing seven contests. A lack of extended playing time…

news.headline: Kacmarek went without a target while logging 21 of 57 snaps on offense in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: After drawing at least one target in each of the previous three games, Kacmarek failed to draw a look from quarterback Kyle McCord, who connected with seven different pass catchers on the day. Kacmarek ran routes on just six of his 21 snaps, as the Dolphins continue to utilize him mainly as a blocker when he's on the field.

news.headline: Traore went without a target while playing six of the Dolphins' 69 snaps on offense in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.story: Meanwhile, Traore tied a season-high with 23 snaps on special teams, where he continues to receive the bulk of his playing time. The reserve tight end has played in all nine of the Dolphins' games to date but has gone without a reception while being targeted once across 39 total snaps on offense.

news.headline: Kolar brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets on Sunday.
news.story: Kolar was cleared to play Sunday after progressing through the league's concussion protocol, and his 30 offensive snaps were ahead of fellow tight ends David Njoku (25) and Oronde Gadsden (23). Kolar's eight-yard catch midway through the first quarter was the only pass that the fifth-year pro saw from Justin Herbert, but no Chargers pass catcher saw more than five targets other then Ladd McConkey (eight). Kolar has…

news.headline: Kolar (concussion) is active for Sunday's game versus the Jets.
news.story: Kolar showed up on the Chargers' first Week 11 injury report Wednesday as a non-participant due to a concussion, and thereafter he managed just one limited session Friday before the team tagged him as questionable for Sunday. Despite his inability to practice fully this week and the prospect of gaining clearance from an independent neurologist shaped up as a difficult combination to overcome, he's available to the…

news.headline: Kolar (concussion) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
news.story: The tight end is still in the concussion protocol, so he'll be up against it to clear the final hurdles, especially after the Chargers played Monday night against Baltimore. If Kolar is ruled out, David Njoku and Oronde Gadsden should handle most of the tight-end duties for the Bolts.

news.headline: Gadsden went without a target while taking the field for 23 of the Chargers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
news.story: Gadsden ranked third in snaps among Chargers tight ends, finishing only slightly behind Charlie Kolar (30) and David Njoku (25). Despite arguably being the most talented pass catcher of the trio, Gadsden was the only one of the three who failed to draw a target in Week 11. The 2025 fifth-round pick has endured a disappointing sophomore campaign, having thus far put together a 20-179-1 receiving line on 30 targets…

news.headline: Gadsden hauled in his lone target for seven yards in Monday's 23-20 win over Baltimore.
news.story: Gadsden went to the locker room during the first half of Monday's game after being poked in the ye, but the second-year tight end was cleared to return for the second quarter. However, his 12 offensive snaps were his lowest since Week 1 against the Cardinals (10), and that lack of playing time coincided with the return of veteran tight end David Njoku, who missed the Chargers' six prior games while on IR due to a…

news.headline: Gadsden (eye) returned to Monday night's game against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
news.story: Gadsden was poked in the eye in the first quarter and had to go to the locker room before returning early in the second quarter. He wasn't targeted in the passing game prior to sustaining the injury.

news.headline: Raridon caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's loss to the Lions in Munich.
news.story: The rookie tight end played his normal allotment of plays, seeing 62.7 percent of the offensive snaps, but the offense as a whole was broken after Drake Maye went out with an ankle injury early in the first quarter. The offense bogged down with Tommy DeVito at the controls, and Raridon's one target was his fewest in a game since Week 2. Raridon also has been held to single-digit receiving yards in two of the last…

news.headline: Long hauled in his lone target for an 11-yard reception in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
news.story: Long ranked third among Cardinals tight ends in playing time, logging 23 of 56 offensive snaps while Trey McBride (45 snaps) and Elijah Higgins (32) paced the position group. In his first two contests back in action since being reinstated from injured reserve Nov. 14 following a five-game absence, Long has notched two receptions for 18 yards on three targets.

news.headline: Long (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
news.story: Long was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the sixth-year pro has been cleared to return from a five-game absence due to a knee injury. He will operate in a rotational role at tight end behind Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins.

news.headline: Higgins caught his lone target for four yards during the Cardinals' 34-7 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.
news.story: The Cardinals offense struggled Sunday with Josh Johnson as the starter in the absence of Carson Beck (back). Of Johnson's 31 pass attempts, 26 of them were split between Trey McBride (14), Harrison Wallace (seven) and Simi Fehoko (five), leaving very little for Higgins and the other Cardinals pass catchers. Higgins has only one catch over his last two outings and a 19-166-1 line on 21 targets through 11…

news.headline: Higgins played 24 of 35 offensive snaps (68.6 percent) but didn't get a target during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
news.story: Week 10 was Higgins' first game since signing a three-year contract extension worth up to $26.8 million. He didn't have much to show for it during Sunday's loss, although the Cardinals finished with a measly 17:37 time of possession, and the offense struggled as a whole with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck under center. Higgins will take an 18-162-1 receiving line on 20 targets through 10 games into Arizona's Week…

news.headline: Bates didn't garner a target during Monday night's 22-20 win over the Bengals.
news.story: Bates went without a target for the fourth straight game. The 29-year-old's 21 offensive snaps ranked third at tight end behind Chig Okonkwo (49) and Ben Sinnott (24), and Bates will continue to have no fantasy value in Week 12 versus the Cardinals.

news.headline: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
news.story: Yankoff sat out the Commanders' contest against the Giants in Week 10 because of a knee injury, but it now looks like he's put it behind him. He figures to resume a depth role at tight end in Week 11 against the Bengals.

news.headline: Jeudy recorded two catches on four targets for 74 yards in a 27-24 victory over the Texans on Sunday.
news.story: Jeudy boosted his final line considerably on a 65-yard connection with Deshaun Watson in the second period. Watson carried the ball into the end zone on the following snap to bring the Browns to within seven points. Jeudy's 74 receiving yards were a season-high mark, though he finished with two or fewer receptions for the third straight week. The veteran wideout is behind both WRs Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion,…

news.headline: Otton caught one pass for eight yards on three targets in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
news.story: The tight end earned just a 9.1 percent target share and continues to be nearly invisible in the box score despite being an every-down player who runs virtually every pass route for the Bucs. Otton has just one touchdown since Week 11 of the 2024 season and has just one career 100-yard receiving game across 73 regular-season contests. He's a touchdown-or-bust fantasy bet who clearly busts far more than he hits.

news.headline: Tremble caught one pass for 18 yards in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: The tight end played on 82 percent of the offensive snaps but only saw one target. Tremble has 36 targets across 10 appearances this season, recording 26 catches for 245 yards and three scores.

news.headline: Tremble (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
news.story: Tremble opened Week 11 prep as a non-participant Wednesday due to a knee injury, which he followed up with limited sessions Thursday and Friday and a questionable tag for Sunday. The same can be said for fellow TE Darren Waller (knee), and both now are available to the Panthers offense. In nine outings this season, Tremble has compiled a 25-227-3 line on 35 targets.

news.headline: Tremble (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.story: Tremble put together a DNP-LP-LP practice log during Week 11 prep while managing a knee injury that he picked up during the Panthers' 20-17 win over the Saints in Week 10. Darren Waller (knee) also is listed as questionable, which leaves Mitchell Evans, Feleipe Franks and Ja'Tavion Sanders as the Panthers' healthy tight ends on the 53-man roster heading into the weekend. Tremble's status for Sunday's game may not…

news.headline: Evans caught all five of his targets for 44 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: Evans was able to reel in a season-high five passes while notching multiple receptions for the fourth time in five weeks. The tight end's biggest moment of the game came in the first quarter when he secured a 23-yard touchdown pass from quarterback Bryce Young, registering his first score of the year. Evans has now caught 17 of 20 targets for 191 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests during the 2026 campaign.

news.headline: Franks played all 21 of his snaps on special teams and was credited with two tackles in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
news.story: Franks has been active for all 10 of the Panthers' games to date, but he's been utilized almost exclusively on special teams. He hasn't logged more than nine snaps on offense in any contest and has yet to draw a target.
